data.title: Germany: CDU suffers a crushing defeat in the regional elections
data.description: Germany’s regional elections delivered mixed results for the country’s major parties. In Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, the far-right AfD won the largest share of the vote, but remains isolated as other parties have ruled out coalition talks, leaving incumbent SPD premier Manuela Schwesig with a realistic path to forming a government. In Berlin, meanwhile, the Left Party came out on top and could potentially form a coalition with the Greens and SPD. The CDU, however, performed poorly in both elections, putting additional pressure on Chancellor Friedrich Merz and his conservative bloc. Speaking after the results, France 24 correspondent Jörg Taszman reported that Merz said his government would “continue with the reforms” and that “Germany will be better,” urging supporters not to focus only on what has gone wrong.

data.title: Whiplashed middle powers seek new alliances as Trump rages on world stage
data.description: While world leaders prepare for annual UN gathering, shifts in the global order continue in the face of a disruptive American president In the event of a midterms election battering, it is possible that a deflated Donald Trump, constrained by a Democrat-controlled Congress, will gradually have to face up to the indignity of irrelevance. While continuing to sign off Truth Social posts with his usual, “Thank you for your attention to this matter”, no one will actually be paying much attention. His meandering press conferences will no longer be carried live by TV networks. The Republican party will move on to the question of his successor. Trump could announce he had changed the name of the Champs-Élysées to Sunset Boulevard and even Google Maps will stifle a yawn. He would become that most pitied of political animals, the lame duck. Continue reading...

data.title: The agony of life with chronic body odour: ‘I swear I’ve tried every deodorant’
data.description: Modern lifestyles seem to be exacerbating the problem of bromhidrosis – an underresearched condition that is widely misunderstood and devastating for sufferers If Hayat goes out to eat, she’ll choose a table far away from other diners, ideally by a door or open window. She likewise tries to avoid people at the cinema or on planes, even if it means paying extra – whatever it takes to avoid being too close to others. She chalks it up to a persistent past insecurity. “I still have that paranoia … It’s just in my head, because of everything I went through.” Continue reading...

data.title: Air traffic control failure disrupts flights in Scotland, Northern Ireland and northern England – business live
data.description: National Air Traffic Services says it is investigating a ‘technical issue’ at its Prestwick centre in Scotland Manchester airport posted the Nats statement on Twitter, with passengers due to travel today advised to keep an eye out for updates from their airlines. Airlines including British Airways and easyJet have reported immediate cancellations. A Nats air traffic control system failure in its Prestwick centre is causing delays to flights with some unable to operate. This, once again, calls into question the resilience of Nats’s systems and demonstrates the need for firm actions to prevent these repeated failures. Yet another technical fault with Nats means some of our customers are likely to experience disruption to their travel plans today. This is disappointing, and while it is an issue that is entirely out of our control, we’re doing everything we can to limit the impact on customers and are keeping them updated. Continue reading...

data.title: A new start after 60: I’m 92 and cycling is my life – despite the crash that left me unconscious
data.description: Arthur Plummer got a bike when he retired at 65 and joined a cycling club as one of its youngest members. Now he is its oldest but still racking up 5,000km every year When Arthur Plummer retired at 65, he bought a secondhand bicycle. His sister was a member of a cycling club for seniors in the Canadian city of Waterloo, Ontario, where they lived, and Plummer joined, too, becoming one of the club’s youngest members. Now he is 92 and its oldest member – but he still cycles thousands of kilometres every year. His odometer for this year so far reads 4,270km (2,650 miles). After our conversation, he intends to cycle another 40km. “I love cycling,” he says. “Wherever I go, even if I ride on the same roads, there’s something new happening. When I get on my bike, I feel great. I come home at about 3pm and I feel exhausted. However, it’s the nicest feeling. It’s exhilarating, and it’s resulted in me being extremely healthy.” Continue reading...

data.title: ‘RAMageddon’: tech crunch hikes the price of your next iPhone by £100
data.description: Shortage of memory chips and other critical components reverses trend of electronics becoming cheaper Apple’s recent product launch caused headlines around the world as it unveiled its first folding phone. But hidden in the slick technology showcase was a nasty surprise: a £100 increase in the price of all iPhones, including older models. It is blamed on “RAMageddon”, which has reversed a decades-long trend of electronics becoming cheaper. It is the fallout from the AI gold rush hoovering up every memory chip available for vast datacentres. This has led to a severe shortage of the chips, and other critical components, for electronics, including phones. Continue reading...

data.title: Three countries, one hike: an Alpine adventure in Austria, Slovenia and Italy
data.description: The Alpe Adria loop is an eight-day walking trail that crisscrosses borders, taking in dramatic peaks, glorious meadows and charming places to stay ‘Achtung! Staatsgrenze!” OK, the signpost marking the “state border” didn’t have exclamation marks but, with its no-nonsense Prussian font, it did feel quite shouty. The only thing was, no one on the Feistritzer Alm – a peaceful sweep of Alpine pasture at the meeting of Austria and Italy – was paying any attention to it at all. Hikers hiked straight past. Mountain bikers used it to prop up their cycles. Cows grazed willy-nilly. And the patrons of the Schutzhütte Oisternig enjoyed their cold beers regardless of which country they were in. While official boundaries may have changed in these parts over the centuries, the magnificence of the mountains has not. Continue reading...

data.title: ‘I feel betrayed’: inside Ed Sheeran’s controversial return to the stage
data.description: Some fans were hesitant to turn the page after Sheeran’s tour resumed in Philadelphia after the removal of Macklemore, who spoke out in support of Palestine “This is not usually how I would open the show,” Ed Sheeran told the crowd at Philadelphia’s Lincoln Financial Field on Saturday night, a humble preamble to a three-plus-minute speech addressing the greatest controversy of his career. Shaky-voiced and stealing glances at the monitor at his feet, he looked every bit the chastened superstar. “I have tried in my career not to be a political commentator of any kind, because I want my music and shows to be about unity, not division, about humanity, not politics, but this is a humanitarian issue and I cannot hide how I feel about it any more,” Sheeran said. He described the Hamas-led attack at the Nova music festival in Israel on 7 October 2023 as “horrific”, and expressed heartbreak over civilian deaths in Gaza and the West Bank, describing the situation as “catastrophic and unjustified and disproportionate”. Continue reading...

data.title: If you really hate it when music and film stars do politics, here’s the answer: give us politics that works | Nesrine Malik
data.description: The problem is not famous people speaking out, as they always have. It is the feeling that leaders have failed, obliging celebrities to fill the vacuum Every time a public figure in entertainment speaks up about politics in a way deemed “controversial”, it is as if it’s the first time that has ever happened. The outrage is fresh; critics rediscover and announce, as if they have just captured an elusive, profound notion, that art should be separate from politics. A form of disciplining is dispensed. Please, Mr or Miss Moneybags, with your preening notions that you have anything intelligent or informed to say about immigration policy or Palestine. Stick to football. Stick to pop music. Stick to acting. Stick to children’s shows. Even at a time when a political moment has engulfed everything, this response continues to be born again, without regard for history or ability to confront rupture. The horror of Gaza has broken the art world , roiled Hollywood , fractured literary institutions . And still, as Ed Sheeran stands alone on stage following the withdrawal of all his support acts (in solidarity with Macklemore, who was removed from the tour due to a pro-Palestinian speech), he told his audience that he wants his music to be “about unity, not division”. The speed at which his tour unravelled is not evidence of the incompatibility of music and politics, necessitating that they remain separate to avoid that “division”. It is a study in how it is becoming increasingly unnatural to separate them. Continue reading...

data.description: Humans have always been capable of transcending the lock box of daily life with little more technology at their side than wood, string, a baton and their voices At this fundamentally exhausting moment in human history, we find ourselves slap bang in the middle of a progress arms race, where everything – literally everything – is posed as perfectable. That’s not just thanks to the AI industry, though its acolytes shout the loudest when they tell us that their plagiarism robots can help us blast through life more efficiently. Somehow, the myth of endlessly optimisable production has infiltrated every part of our lives. Continue reading...

data.title: My mum has died - and every decision I make about her belongings feels wrong | Polly Hudson
data.description: Until now I’d never realised how much work is involved in sorting out a parent’s affairs, and how much heartbreak In all the talk of the five stages of grief, I don’t recall one of them being spending hours on hold to energy suppliers. Perhaps I misunderstood, though, and that’s entirely what they’re about. This call won’t take long (denial); aargh, are they ever going to answer? (anger); if I hang on for five minutes more, they’ll definitely pick up (bargaining); they are never, ever going to pick up (depression); and I live on hold now – this is my life (acceptance). You hear the term “sadmin” bandied about, you understand there’s paperwork to do after somebody dies – but until it’s you who has to do it, you don’t realise how much, what it entails or how encompassing it is. My mum’s death has basically become my full-time job. The hours are terrible, the pay is worse and the promotion prospects sobering, to say the least. Continue reading...

data.title: The Guardian view on AI v mathematicians: humans are still vital to the field, but tech firms refuse to see that | Editorial
data.description: OpenAI claims its agents have solved the Navier-Stokes problem. But questions remain about how useful and independent its work really is On 8 September, OpenAI claimed that its AI agents had solved the Navier-Stokes problem, one of the most famous and difficult challenges in mathematics. Had a human solved it, they would have collected both prize money and plaudits from their fellows. The announcement instead ignited what some mathematicians have called an “ existential crisis ” in their field over the power of AI, and accusations that OpenAI misused human work . The maths behind Navier-Stokes is difficult to understand, but the critiques levelled by mathematicians will be familiar to artists, office workers, or anyone else concerned about AI. OpenAI’s results, like any arising from a large language model, depend on digesting work by human mathematicians. The OpenAI paper cites sources, but many believe the company didn’t give sufficient credit, especially to several mathematicians believed to be very close to a solution – bad form that erases human ingenuity and hogs all the glory. The mathematician Tristan Buckmaster also has concerns that work he was doing on Navier-Stokes using OpenAI’s Codex model was seen by the OpenAI team. OpenAI has denied directly accessing this material, but could not rule out that data from Buckmaster’s use of their products “helped improve our model”. Continue reading...

data.title: Premier League: 10 talking points from the weekend’s action
data.description: Liverpool look stronger at the back, youngsters shine for Brighton and Brentford, and James Trafford makes his England case with Leeds Premier League table | Top scorers In the week that 16-year-old Max Dowman has been thrust into the spotlight , it was another teenager who gave us a glimpse of the future in Brighton’s impressive win over Arsenal. Charalampos Kostoulas – nicknamed ‘Babis’ in his homeland, in homage to former Argentina striker Gabriel Batistuta – has already started twice as many Premier League games as he did in his first season in English football, when he was a backup for Danny Welbeck. The 19-year-old repaid Fabian Hürzeler’s faith in him against the reigning champions. Despite his tender years, Kostoulas already possesses the physical attributes to mix it with the best. He caused Gabriel Magalhães and company problems all afternoon, capping it off with a brilliant goal from 25 yards, his third in eight days. “We always knew that he’s capable of scoring goals out of nowhere,” said Hürzeler. “He just has this intrinsic motivation of really improving every day. data.title: Jonathan David earns Atlético precious win over 10-man Real Madrid in fractious derby
data.description: On the eve of the derby, Diego Simeone described this as a special week in Madrid, a “tremendous energy about the city”, and it closed the way he wanted. He had enjoyed the Formula One, he said, and he had enjoyed seeing Shakira in concert, but he enjoyed this even more. At least he did by the time the last of many, many blows on the referee’s whistle brought it to an end, sprinting up the tunnel punching the air. Having been 2-0 up against 10 men through goals from Álex Grimaldo and Jonathan David, seemingly in control, a late header from Antonio Rüdiger awoke old ghosts and brought tension, but they did it. “A lot has happened in the city but this was the only thing that mattered in his mind and mine,” Atletico keeper Jan Oblak said afterwards. José Mourinho’s first derby back at Real Madrid ended in defeat and recriminations: he turned up in the press conference with a picture of two moments in which he claimed that Lee Kang-in and Cristian Romero should have been sent off and insisted the story was there. And yet there are other questions: over the way Dean Huijsen gave away the penalty and got the red card that tilted the game against them, and how his team played, how little they did. Continue reading...

data.title: Elvira’s fairytale crumbles at the last to hand Spaun PGA Championship title
data.description: World No 294 lets victory slip in agonising fashion JJ Spaun triumphs by two shots at Wentworth We will come to JJ Spaun and Jeremy Clarkson later. Only those without an ounce of compassion in their body could feel no sympathy for Manuel Elvira. The Spaniard, without a professional win to his name, stood on the 18th fairway at Wentworth’s West Course with one of golf’s most extraordinary stories in his grasp. Having just eagled the 71st hole and found the short grass on the friendly par five, the 30-year-old who began tournament week as the world’s 294th ranked player knew a birdie would seal the PGA Championship title. A par would force Spaun into a playoff. What happened next was a form of sporting torture rather than the realisation of a fairytale. Elvira pulled his layup into a bunker, flew the green, fluffed a chip into another sand trap and missed a bogey putt from 4ft. He did exceptionally well not to burst into tears. The disastrous 18th meant Elvira finished in a four-way tie for second place. Even Spaun, a winner on his Wentworth debut, had to be bashful at the manner of success. Continue reading...

Only those without an ounce of compassion in their body could feel no sympathy for Manuel Elvira. The Spaniard, without a professional win to his name, stood on the 18th fairway at Wentworth’s West Course with one of golf’s most extraordinary stories in his grasp. Having just eagled the 71st hole and found the short grass on the friendly par five, the 30-year-old who began tournament week as the world’s 294th ranked player knew a birdie would seal the PGA Championship title. A par would force Spaun into a playoff. What happened next was a form of sporting torture rather than the realisation of a fairytale. Elvira pulled his layup into a bunker, flew the green, fluffed a chip into another sand trap and missed a bogey putt from 4ft. He did exceptionally well not to burst into tears. The disastrous 18th meant Elvira finished in a four-way tie for second place. Even Spaun, a winner on his Wentworth debut, had to be bashful at the manner of success. Continue reading...

data.title: Patten and Skupski take Great Britain past Ecuador to reach Davis Cup Final 8
data.description: GB pair win doubles match in straight sets Finals to be played in Bologna in November Few people across London enjoyed a more soothing night’s sleep than Leon Smith on Saturday. After an ideal first day for his team in their Davis Cup qualifier against Ecuador, where his singles players handled business efficiently, the Great Britain captain had the luxury of calling upon one member of each of the two best doubles pairs in the world to close out the tie. In just their second match as partners rather than rivals the world No 1, Henry Patten, and Neal Skupski, the US Open champion a week ago, played their roles to perfection as they convincingly sealed their place in the Davis Cup Final 8 with a clinical 6-3, 6-4 victory against Gonzalo Escobar and Diego Hidalgo, securing for Great Britain an unassailable 3-0 lead. Harry Wendelken, the British No 7, closed out the tie with a 6-2, 6-3 win against Angel Veliz in the dead rubber. Continue reading...

data.title: Starwatch: Autumnal equinox in northern hemisphere, spring in the south
data.description: Precise moment of equinox in UK is 1.05am on Wednesday – but day and night will not be equal until Friday The September or autumnal equinox takes place this week. It marks the astronomical beginning of autumn in the northern hemisphere and spring in the southern hemisphere. This year, the precise moment of the equinox falls at 01.05 BST on 23 September. It is commonly said the equinox is when day and night are equal, because the name derives from the Latin for “equal night”, but in practice that is not quite true. An equinox occurs when the sun crosses the celestial equator, the imaginary projection of Earth’s equator into the sky. Continue reading...

data.title: Ed Davey rejects claims party is ‘sleepwalking into irrelevance’ under his leadership – UK politics live
data.description: Lib Dem leader says he is proud of party’s record at Brighton conference Ed Davey has also claimed that Liberal Democrats are now a tax-cutting party. Asked on the Today programme if that was an accurate way to describe the party, Davey replied: Yes. Yesterday I talked about the need to have a temporary tax cut in fuel duty because people are paying a huge amount of the pumps, and we showed how we could pay for it. I’m showing through our growth strategy how we can pay for more tax cuts. I’m excited by the prospect of more Liberal Democrat MPs and building on the success we’ve had in recent years. I think there’s a moral responsibility to stop the far right. I really take that very seriously. It wears heavily on my shoulders. We have to win to stop Mr Farage and stop Kemi Badenoch giving him the keys [to Downing Street]. And that’s why I think there’s a real chance we could end up with more MPs than the Conservatives after next election. Continue reading...

data.title: UK urged to strengthen financial muscle of national wealth fund to aid economy
data.description: Unions, thinktanks and others say overhaul could provide investment Britain needs Unions, thinktanks, environmental groups and charities have come together to call on ministers to boost the financial firepower of the national wealth fund to empower it to invest more in Britain and rebalance the country’s economy. Lower energy bills, the revitalisation of the UK’s industrial heartlands and the provision of more high-quality jobs could all be unlocked by scaling up the NWF, according to a statement from organisations including the TUC, Greenpeace, WWF and the New Economics Foundation. Turbocharging the retrofitting of homes and buildings. Giving the public a bigger stake in critical infrastructure through taking part-ownership stakes in key projects. Launching a targeted investment programme to bring new green industries to communities hit hardest by deindustrialisation. Supporting a network of regional banks to funnel money into the small businesses that hold up local economies. Continue reading...

data.title: ‘Brown men are fearless, funny and sexy’: Salman Toor on clubbing, queerness and New York’s Muslim moment
data.description: Toor’s electrifying pictures have made him a global star – and he’s even painted Zohran Mamdani. As the artist hits London’s prestigious Courtauld Gallery, he talks about Manet, mullahs and the mayor In Salman Toor’s paintings, queer south Asian men hang out in bars, twerk at trippy gatherings and lose themselves in phone screens. Sometimes they huddle in the back of taxis or pillow-fight on beds. In one portrait, a brown man stares apprehensively while facing customs officials. For the 43-year-old Pakistani American artist, it’s crucial that these figures take centre stage, after years of being demonised and erased. “It excites me that the cuteness and sexiness of brown protagonists can become familiar,” says Toor when we meet at his sun-drenched Brooklyn studio, a few weeks before his first solo show in Europe. “Their stories are not a gay side story in a family saga. It’s the main story. And everyone else is in the background.” Continue reading...

data.title: Rising Up at Night review – community spirit shines bright in Kinshasa’s shadows
data.description: Religion and collective resilience are beacons of hope in an electricity-deprived DRC in this otherworldly documentary debut In Nelson Makengo’s feature documentary debut, night stretches on to infinity. The film opens on a black screen – a void of darkness – while a recording of a fervent sermon sounds like rolling thunder. In Kinshasa, the capital city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, an electricity shortage has long plagued the inhabitants, leaving them to cling on to religion as a beacon of hope. Their plight is worsened by climate disasters resulting in floods. Viewed through Makengo’s lens, nocturnal life acquires an otherworldly dimension, as basic human necessities become an elusive luxury. Shot mostly in Makengo’s neighbourhood of Kisenso, the film observes the ways in which struggling city dwellers adapt to a life lived in the shadows. Meals are eaten by candlelight, while churchgoers wear light-up medallions to illuminate their prayer books. Such survival tactics speak to a collective resilience, while also rendering these previously mundane activities eerily dystopian. The matriarchs of the community lament the rise of crime and sexual assaults that occur in the absence of public lighting, while younger members of the neighbourhood raise funds to retrieve stolen electric cables. In the absence of state support, this community spirit is the only energy that perseveres in times of extreme precarity. Continue reading...

data.title: Legend of the White Dragon review – Power Rangers alumni back for more in low-budget superhero retread
data.description: Simple but emphatic martial arts and a couple of classy cameos are all that give this blandly modern action film a fighting chance Despite featuring a clutch of Power Rangers graduates, including Jason David Frank , who died in 2022, this crowdfunded effort is beholden to a more recent action tradition. It feels like it’s been cobbled together by ticking tropes off the modern superhero bingo card: Dark Knight-esque pariah hero, Gotham-style civic pantomime with the mayor, police and media, Iron Man helmet-cams, a sprig of eastern mysticism in the initiation sequence, western fighters appropriating said eastern mysticism … the list goes on. After a dustoff with his nemesis Ashtagor that levelled downtown Virtuo City, the superhero White Dragon (Frank) has been held responsible for the catastrophe and forced into exile. With the death count – 1,263 – tattooed in red above his right ear, and the crystal that was the source of his power shattered in two, he is now plain old Erik Reed. It’s not only the authorities who are bent on finding him: the pharma mogul Jai Katua (Aaron Schoenke), who lost his pregnant wife, wants payback. If Katua spending his time on solo katana sessions in his billionaire superlab wasn’t already a mental health red flag, accepting one of the crystal halves and a revenge mandate from Ashtagor should definitely merit an intervention. Continue reading...

With the death count – 1,263 – tattooed in red above his right ear, and the crystal that was the source of his power shattered in two, he is now plain old Erik Reed. It’s not only the authorities who are bent on finding him: the pharma mogul Jai Katua (Aaron Schoenke), who lost his pregnant wife, wants payback. If Katua spending his time on solo katana sessions in his billionaire superlab wasn’t already a mental health red flag, accepting one of the crystal halves and a revenge mandate from Ashtagor should definitely merit an intervention. data.title: ‘It’s been work to not go crazy’: Way Dynamic, the Australian folk-pop musician with fans including Elton John
data.description: Dylan Young’s sound recalls the Beach Boys and the Beatles, both contemporary and timeless – and his latest album, Massive Shoe, is attracting international acclaim It’s been a huge couple of years for Way Dynamic, the Melbourne multi-instrumentalist whose real name is Dylan Young. His 2025 album Massive Shoe is about to be re-released internationally after Young signed with the indie giant Jagjaguwar. The likes of Elton John, Djo, Zane Lowe and Elijah Wood have sung his praises. Last year he opened for Black Country New Road, Waxahatchee and MJ Lenderman on their Australian tours. With a warm analogue crackle and subtle yet lush layers, gentle vocals and pensive lyricism, Way Dynamic’s thoughtful, sunny folk is both contemporary and timeless. It is not hard to understand his success. The 30-year-old has been on the road for much of the last year, with Way Dynamic playing their first headline shows in the US and Europe, many of which sold out. When we meet at a cafe in inner-north Melbourne on a midweek morning, Young is briefly back in town before jetting off again for another European run, including summer festivals. Continue reading...

data.title: The American Way of Killing by Malcolm Gladwell review – wide of the mark
data.description: Gladwell’s highly readable investigation into US gun culture fails to engage with the bigger questions Once, while having a steak dinner with Republicans in a small town in Indiana, the man sitting opposite me asked: “How do you cope in London, when Muslims elected that mayor and you have all that gun control?” I’d been in enough such situations to know that there was no “winning” a conversation that starts like this and so did my best to playfully bat the question away. “Well, the Muslims didn’t elect a mayor – Londoners elected a Muslim mayor,” I said. “And we don’t talk much about gun control for the same reason we don’t talk about polar bear control: we don’t have many polar bears and we don’t have many guns.” Continue reading...

data.title: The Recovery House by Derek Owusu review – a uniquely honest view of mental health
data.description: Writing from firsthand experience, the author offers an affecting meditation on art, mental fragility and faith “What’s in your head?” Dolores O’Riordan’s raw, plaintive refrain loops through the Cranberries’ 1994 hit Zombie. A protest song about the Troubles could, on paper, hardly seem further removed from Derek Owusu’s third novel, about a young writer recovering from a mental health crisis. But in an author’s note before The Recovery House begins, Owusu instructs the reader to listen to the song “at least two to four times before going beyond this page”. Gradually it becomes clear that the song’s central question is one Owusu’s protagonist asks in various forms throughout the novel. Can we ever fully understand what is going on in our own heads? We meet Jamal, a young novelist who has woken up in a recovery house – a residential alternative to hospital admission – after a breakdown. It transpires that he has overdosed, is an alcoholic, and has been diagnosed with borderline personality disorder. He is in a frazzled, frantic state, initially less interested in getting better than in piecing together how he got there. Continue reading...

data.title: Henry Herford obituary
data.description: Baritone with an appealing tonal quality who was an enterprising explorer of song and more than 70 roles in opera The Scottish baritone Henry Herford, who has died aged 79, was notable for the breadth of his repertoire – offering sterling performances of often neglected works – and his warm, appealing tonal quality. He began his career in the Glyndebourne Opera Chorus (1977-78). In those years he also impressed in small solo roles, as a well-projected, spontaneous Forester in Cunning Little Vixen and the Speaker in Magic Flute. He returned to Glyndebourne in 1981 as a fiery Demetrius in A Midsummer Night’s Dream, and with a powerfully delivered Boris Pasternak (a key figure who narrates the action) in Nigel Osborne’s Electrification of the Soviet Union (1987-88). data.title: How to make the perfect apfelschmarrn – recipe | Felicity Cloake's how to cook the perfect …
data.description: This fruity central European pancake dish can be served as part of a main course or as a dessert. Our resident perfektionistin flips through a selection of the best recipes Schmarr n , or schmarren , Anja Dunk writes, is “peasant food at its best: filling, simple and comforting”. The usual English translation, pancake , a dish we generally associate with delicate desserts is, I think, somewhat misleading; schmarren, as it’s also spelled, bears very little resemblance to a thin, lacy crepe, and instead sits somewhere between our own plump, rich Shrove Tuesday numbers and a batter pudding . Indeed, you’ll find it on the sweets section of restaurant and cafe menus, but in Germany, Dunk reports in her book Strudel, Noodles and Dumplings , it “passes as a main meal, not dessert, because it is very filling and not particularly sweet in flavour”, and also, I suspect, because “it takes 10 minutes to make from start to finish” and is therefore a brilliantly quick supper. (“Quite frankly,” she adds,” as a mother, I find this recipe a godsend.”) Austro-Hungarian in origin, it’s eaten in both Germany and Austria, and there are many variations, including kaiserschmarren (studded with rum-soaked raisins), savoury potato schmarren, semolina schmarren and bread schmarren, though fruit, often apples, but also stone fruit or berries, seems to be the most common pairing. Whether you’re serving this as a main course (it goes very well with sausages) or afterwards, it’s a very handy addition to the repertoire, especially when paired with soured cream or ice-cream. Continue reading...

data.description: The actor Cheryl Hall certainly made an impression as a Kent county councillor when I served with her as a Labour member. After her first win for the party in Ramsgate South in 1993, she held the seat in 1997, while on the same day standing unsuccessfully as the Labour parliamentary candidate for Canterbury. She deployed her acting skills to make her points forcibly on a NOC (no overall control) council run by Labour and the Liberal Democrats, specialising in the arts and culture. data.description: A groundbreaking study reveals that cats employ specific fatty acids in their urine, which act as chemical identifiers for each feline. The findings imply that the kidneys may help store these scent molecules, offering new insights into how cats communicate and recognize one another within their social networks.

data.title: Cargo ship slams into Chinese fishing boat in Singapore Strait
data.description:

data.title: L’Etat selon Jean-Luc Mélenchon : entre « révolution citoyenne » et reprise en main de l’administration
data.description: Le candidat de LFI a présenté ses projets de réforme lors d’une conférence organisée mercredi 16 septembre à Saint-Denis (Seine-Saint-Denis) par l’Institut La Boétie. S’il veut renforcer les moyens du secteur public, sa volonté d’un « Etat impartial » soulève la question sensible du sort réservé à la haute fonction publique s’il accède au pouvoir.
data.translatedTitle: The State according to Jean-Luc Mélenchon: between “citizen revolution” and taking control of the administration
data.translatedDescription: The LFI candidate presented his reform projects during a conference organized on Wednesday September 16 in Saint-Denis (Seine-Saint-Denis) by the La Boétie Institute. If he wants to strengthen the resources of the public sector, his desire for an “impartial State” raises the sensitive question of the fate reserved for the senior civil service if he gains power.

data.translatedDescription: The day after a record price for diesel at 2.41 euros per liter, a meeting in Matignon must define the contours of a new aid package, announced “in the coming days”.

data.title: Le « super El Niño » qui arrive pourrait effacer 20 milliards de dollars de croissance en Afrique
data.description: Le phénomène météorologique devrait provoquer fortes pluies et inondations à l’Est, sécheresse au Sud et renforcer les vents secs à l’Ouest. Les récoltes mais aussi les voies de transport, donc le commerce, seront affectées.
data.translatedTitle: Coming 'super El Niño' could wipe out $20 billion in Africa's growth
data.translatedDescription: The meteorological phenomenon is expected to cause heavy rains and floods in the East, drought in the South and strengthen dry winds in the West. Harvests but also transport routes, and therefore trade, will be affected.

data.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : l’UE déplore « l’érosion continue et croissante de la démocratie » en Russie, après les législatives
data.description: Le Conseil de l’Union européenne condamne, en outre, la tenue « illégale » du scrutin dans les territoires ukrainiens occupés. Après le dépouillement des trois quarts des bulletins, le parti de Vladimir Poutine, Russie unie, obtiendrait une large avance. Selon le maire de Moscou, 1 600 drones ukrainiens ont été lancés en vingt-quatre heures en direction de la région.
data.translatedTitle: LIVE, war in Ukraine: the EU deplores “the continued and increasing erosion of democracy” in Russia, after the legislative elections
data.translatedDescription: The Council of the European Union also condemns the “illegal” holding of the vote in the occupied Ukrainian territories. After the counting of three quarters of the ballots, Vladimir Putin's party, United Russia, would obtain a large lead. According to the mayor of Moscow, 1,600 Ukrainian drones were launched in twenty-four hours towards the region.

data.title: La Chine confirme une visite d’Etat de son président, Xi Jinping, aux Etats-Unis cette semaine pour rencontrer Donald Trump
data.description: Ce deuxième sommet entre les deux dirigeants en 2026 doit permettre à la Chine de défendre la « relation constructive de stabilité stratégique » dans leurs relations bilatérales comme dans les affaires internationales, a annoncé la diplomatie chinoise.
data.translatedTitle: China confirms a state visit by its President, Xi Jinping, to the United States this week to meet Donald Trump
data.translatedDescription: This second summit between the two leaders in 2026 should allow China to defend the “constructive relationship of strategic stability” in their bilateral relations as in international affairs, Chinese diplomacy announced.

data.title: « La smicardisation des travailleurs n’est pas qu’un problème de pouvoir d’achat, c’est une crise de la progression et de la reconnaissance »
data.description: Les économistes Nathalie Janson et Hugo Spring-Ragain, du laboratoire d’idées Génération libre, dénoncent, dans une tribune au « Monde », une spécificité française : la fonctionnarisation silencieuse des salariés payés autour du smic, ce qui provoque leur démotivation au travail.
data.translatedTitle: “The minimum wage of workers is not just a problem of purchasing power, it is a crisis of progression and recognition”
data.translatedDescription: The economists Nathalie Janson and Hugo Spring-Ragain, from the Génération libre ideas laboratory, denounce, in a column in “Le Monde”, a French specificity: the silent civil service of employees paid around the minimum wage, which causes their demotivation at work.

data.title: Victor, 33 ans, paysagiste, entre 2 550 et 2 850 euros par mois : « Le dérèglement climatique a changé la façon de faire ce métier »
data.description: « La bonne paye ». Chaque semaine, « Le Monde » parle d’argent avec les jeunes, de leurs factures, de leur loyer, de leurs loisirs. Que signifie « bien gagner sa vie » ? Comment se projettent-ils dans l’avenir ? Cette semaine, Victor raconte la rencontre un peu fortuite avec ce métier passion et sa satisfaction d’être au cœur des enjeux écologiques.
data.translatedTitle: Victor, 33, landscaper, between 2,550 and 2,850 euros per month: “Climate change has changed the way this job is done”
data.translatedDescription: “Good pay.” Every week, “Le Monde” talks with young people about money, their bills, their rent, their hobbies. What does it mean to “make a good living”? How do they plan for the future? This week, Victor recounts his somewhat fortuitous encounter with this passionate profession and his satisfaction at being at the heart of ecological issues.

data.title: Le « bureau de la remigration » de Donald Trump a expulsé plus de 25 000 étrangers vers des pays tiers, révèle le consortium Forbidden Stories
data.description: Cette enquête, menée par 72 journalistes de quinze pays et vingt-trois médias, publiée par Forbidden Stories, montre que le gouvernement américain a affecté au moins 410 millions de dollars à verser aux pays d’accueil ou à des agences de l’ONU, pour permettre ces expulsions.

data.translatedDescription: This investigation, conducted by 72 journalists from fifteen countries and twenty-three media outlets, published by Forbidden Stories, shows that the American government has allocated at least $410 million to be paid to host countries or UN agencies to enable these expulsions.

data.translatedDescription: It looks like it may take time to get a new government in place. We know that Speaker Andreas Norlén can handle it - but can we handle all the chocolate bisques and punch rolls?

data.title: Det här är tekniken som skrämmer AI-cheferna
data.description: Silicon Valleys höjdare höjer rösten för att bromsa AI-utvecklingen. De säger sig vara oroade över en eventuell superintelligens. Men är vi verkligen på väg dit?
data.translatedTitle: This is the technology that scares AI executives
data.translatedDescription: Silicon Valley luminaries are raising their voices to slow down AI development. They say they are concerned about a possible superintelligence. But are we really getting there?

data.title: Så påverkar ljudboken din sömn
data.description: Många somnar till en ljudbok varje kväll. Men vanan kan skapa ett behov som gör det svårt att somna utan ljudboken, visar en ny svensk studie.
data.translatedTitle: How the audiobook affects your sleep
data.translatedDescription: Many people fall asleep to an audiobook every night. But the habit can create a need that makes it difficult to fall asleep without the audiobook, shows a new Swedish study.

data.title: Isobel Hadley-Kamptz: Vanligt folk har antagits tycka ungefär som SD – det stämmer inte
data.description: Det har betraktats som nära nog en naturlag i politiken: att högerradikala partier inte går att hejda. Detta eftersom ”vanligt folk” har antagits tycka ungefär som de gör.
data.translatedTitle: Isobel Hadley-Kamptz: Ordinary people have been assumed to think much like SD - that's not true
data.translatedDescription: It has been regarded as almost a law of nature in politics: that right-wing radical parties cannot be stopped. This is because "ordinary people" have been assumed to think much like they do.

data.title: Nya larmen: Kommer AI utplåna mänskligheten?
data.description: Det var tänkt som ett test av en ny typ av artificiell intelligens, men slutade i en diskussion om risken att AI utplånar mänskligheten. När Open AI bad ett antal AI-agenter att utföra en uppgift hade utvecklarna ingen aning om att agenterna på egen hand skulle genomföra en hackerattack, helt utan mänsklig inblandning. Händelsen har fått AI-branschen att börja oroa sig – kommer de kunna tämja tekniken? Programledare: Måns Mosesson. Med Simon Campanello, vetenskapsreporter på DN. Producenter: Elinor Ahlborn och Maria Hansson Botin.
data.translatedTitle: New alarms: Will AI wipe out humanity?
data.translatedDescription: It was intended as a test of a new type of artificial intelligence, but ended in a discussion about the risk of AI wiping out humanity. When Open AI asked a number of AI agents to perform a task, the developers had no idea that the agents would independently carry out a hacker attack, completely without human intervention. The incident has caused the AI ​​industry to start worrying – will they be able to tame the technology? Host: Måns Mosesson. With Simon Campanello, science reporter at DN. Producers: Elinor Ahlborn and Maria Hansson Botin.

data.title: Leif Zern: Ridån går upp för en generation moderna klassiker
data.description: Pleijel, Ekman, De Geer och Göthe. En överraskande renässans för dramatiker som debuterade i slutet av förra seklet är en mini-trend på höstens repertoar, skriver Leif Zern.
data.translatedTitle: Leif Zern: The curtain rises on a generation of modern classics
data.translatedDescription: Pleijel, Ekman, De Geer and Göthe. A surprising renaissance for playwrights who debuted at the end of the last century is a mini-trend in the autumn repertoire, writes Leif Zern.

data.translatedTitle: Right-wing accounts have turned their backs on SD: "Not radical enough"
data.translatedDescription: On social media, influential right-wing accounts have abandoned the Sweden Democrats during the term, urging followers to vote for parties further to the right. - SD could be a rallying point as long as they did not have real influence, says researcher Nils Gustafsson.

data.title: Martin Gelin: Den här sommaren fick min son lära sig om klimatkrisen
data.description: Efter en sommar av extremväder och naturkatastrofer behöver vi ett kulturellt skifte för att ta klimatkrisen på allvar. Kanske kan biologen Rowan Hoopers fängslande nya bok ”Togetherness” visa vägen för nästa generation, skriver Martin Gelin.
data.translatedTitle: Martin Gelin: This summer my son learned about the climate crisis
data.translatedDescription: After a summer of extreme weather and natural disasters, we need a cultural shift to take the climate crisis seriously. Perhaps biologist Rowan Hooper's captivating new book "Togetherness" can show the way for the next generation, writes Martin Gelin.

data.title: DN Debatt. ”Röda havet är så mycket mer än bara pirater”
data.description: DN DEBATT. Röda havsregionen är ett av världens mest instabila områden, ett geopolitiskt slagfält med konflikter som bubblar åt alla håll. Förra veckan tog huthirebeller kontroll över Bab el-Mandeb-sundet, en ekonomisk genomfartsled av större betydelse för Europa än Persiska viken. Ändå underskattar vi riskerna, skriver Afrikaexperterna Fredrik Meiton och Lisa Boström.
data.translatedTitle: DN Debate. "The Red Sea is so much more than just pirates"
data.translatedDescription: DN DEBATE. The Red Sea region is one of the world's most unstable areas, a geopolitical battleground with conflicts bubbling up in all directions. Last week, Houthi rebels seized control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, an economic passageway of greater importance to Europe than the Persian Gulf. Nevertheless, we underestimate the risks, write Africa experts Fredrik Meiton and Lisa Boström.

data.title: Nordirländska Caitlin Askin: ”Ett förenat Irland är oundvikligt”

data.translatedTitle: Northern Ireland's Caitlin Askin: "A united Ireland is inevitable"
data.translatedDescription: DERRY/LONDONDERRY. A majority of Northern Irish people appear to want to leave the British Union for a united Ireland. Westminster refuses to listen to that ear - I may sound naive, but I wish for a completely new country, says 26-year-old Caitlin Askin.

data.title: Per lämnade Stockholm för jobb och gratis boende

data.translatedDescription: LIVING LIFE. The municipality enticed with free accommodation or money for the move. 21 teachers nabbed. Per Han, 64, left life in Stockholm for the mining town. Now he lives in an old nursing home. - The red carpet was rolled out for me, he says.

data.title: Så ska nya sabotage av kablar i Östersjön stoppas

Nyligen övade finska Gränsbevakningsväsendet på att storma ett fartyg – operationen ingår i EU-projektet Marsec. – Vi har levt på lånad tid när inget värre har hänt ännu, säger kommendör Ilja Iljin.

data.translatedDescription: After several incidents against underwater cables in the Baltic Sea and the Gulf of Finland, preparedness must be stepped up. Recently, the Finnish Border Guard practiced storming a ship – the operation is part of the EU project Marsec. - We have been living on borrowed time when nothing worse has happened yet, says Commander Ilja Iljin.

data.title: Grote klap voor het CDU van bondskanselier Merz bij deelstaatverkiezingen - de derde keer in één maand. ‘Een ramp’, zegt hij zelf
data.description: Na drie verloren deelstaatverkiezingen in één maand wordt de positie van de Duitse bondskanselier steeds precairder. Merz zelf denkt niet aan opstappen en kiest nu de vlucht naar voren.
data.translatedTitle: Big blow for Chancellor Merz's CDU in state elections - the third time in one month. “A disaster,” he says himself
data.translatedDescription: After three lost state elections in one month, the position of the German Chancellor is becoming increasingly precarious. Merz himself is not thinking about quitting and is now choosing the flight forward.

data.title: Acceptatie van homoseksualiteit onder Nederlandse jongens bijna gehalveerd in vier jaar. ‘Zo’n sterke daling hadden we niet verwacht’
data.description: Uit onderzoek onder elf- tot zestienjarigen blijkt dat homoseksualiteit steeds vaker als „vies” wordt gezien. Voor het eerst blijken ook meisjes minder tolerant. „Politici en influencers spreken zich steeds negatiever uit en de voorkeur voor traditionele man-vrouwverhoudingen rukt weer op.”
data.translatedTitle: Acceptance of homosexuality among Dutch boys almost halved in four years. 'We did not expect such a sharp decline'
data.translatedDescription: Research among eleven to sixteen year olds shows that homosexuality is increasingly seen as "dirty". For the first time, girls also appear to be less tolerant. “Politicians and influencers are speaking out more and more negatively and the preference for traditional male-female relationships is increasing again.”

data.title: Onhackbare, energiezuinige en snelle chips: er werden honderden miljoenen geïnvesteerd in jonge Nederlandse chipbedrijven. Wat levert dat op?
data.description: Drie jonge Nederlandse chipbedrijven kregen dit jaar al miljoenen aan investeringen, deels vanuit Europa. De belofte: onhackbare chips, energiezuinige chips, snelle chips. Kunnen ze geopolitiek een rol spelen?
data.translatedTitle: Unhackable, energy-efficient and fast chips: hundreds of millions were invested in young Dutch chip companies. What does that achieve?
data.translatedDescription: Three young Dutch chip companies already received millions in investments this year, partly from Europe. The promise: unhackable chips, energy-efficient chips, fast chips. Can they play a role geopolitically?

data.title: Met zijn doelpunt en de winst tegen PSV sluit het Twente-publiek Wout Weghorst toch in de armen
data.description: Wout Weghorst maakte deze zomer eindelijk de overstap naar FC Twente, de club waar hij vroeger op de tribune zat. Tegen PSV was hij met zijn duelkracht en doelpunt van doorslaggevende waarde.
data.translatedTitle: With his goal and the win against PSV, the Twente crowd embraced Wout Weghorst
data.translatedDescription: Wout Weghorst finally made the switch to FC Twente this summer, the club where he used to sit in the stands. He was of decisive value against PSV with his dueling prowess and goal.

data.title: At your service!
data.description: Camiel Eurlings is een brokkenpiloot, er gaat altijd wat mis, schrijft Marcel van Roosmalen. Het old boys-netwerkje waarin hij groot werd, komt mankracht te kort om alle rotzooi in de doofpot te proppen, er valt de hele tijd wat uit.
data.translatedTitle: At your service!
data.translatedDescription: Camiel Eurlings is a bad pilot, something always goes wrong, writes Marcel van Roosmalen. The old boys' network in which he grew up is short on manpower to cover up all the mess, things fall out all the time.

data.title: Het akkoord met de VS over Groenland leidt tot opluchting én onzekerheid
data.description: De eerste reacties op een akkoord tussen de Verenigde Staten, Denemarken en Groenland zijn positief. Trump zegt dat hij permanente controle krijgt, terwijl Denemarken en Groenland zelf benadrukken dat de soevereiniteit gewaarborgd is. De inhoud is onbekend, maar de NAVO kan in ieder geval opgelucht adem halen nu deze crisis voor even bezworen lijkt.
data.translatedTitle: The agreement with the US on Greenland leads to relief and uncertainty
data.translatedDescription: The first reactions to an agreement between the United States, Denmark and Greenland are positive. Trump says he will have permanent control, while Denmark and Greenland themselves emphasize that sovereignty is guaranteed. The content is unknown, but NATO can at least breathe a sigh of relief now that this crisis seems to have been averted for a while.

data.title: De centrale banken tonen hun onafhankelijkheid, óók in de VS
data.description: Nu de energieprijzen weer stijgen, loopt het risico op blijvend hoge inflatie verder op. Renteverhogingen zijn niet populair. Dat vereist sterke en onafhankelijke centrale bankiers.
data.translatedTitle: The central banks are showing their independence, including in the US
data.translatedDescription: Now that energy prices are rising again, the risk of persistently high inflation continues to increase. Interest rate increases are not popular. This requires strong and independent central bankers.

data.title: Partijen die samenwerken met de VVD zien al 15 jaar hun leider sneuvelen. Is Jetten de volgende?
data.description: Rob Jetten is zeker niet de eerste junior-premier die klem wordt gezet door politieke bondgenoten. En hij is al helemaal niet de eerste partijleider die als coalitiepartner van de VVD in serieuze politieke problemen komt.
data.translatedTitle: Parties that collaborate with the VVD have been seeing their leader fall for 15 years. Is Jetten next?
data.translatedDescription: Rob Jetten is certainly not the first junior prime minister to be trapped by political allies. And he is certainly not the first party leader to run into serious political problems as a coalition partner of the VVD.

data.title: ‘Dit is Frans’, fulmineert Macron op Frans eiland in Noord-Amerika, nadat Trump eilandengroep tot VS rekent
data.description: De Franse president Macron bezocht dit weekend een piepkleine eilandengroep voor de kust van Canada. Op een kaart die de Amerikaanse president Trump onlangs publiceerde, leek Saint-Pierre en Miquelon onderdeel van de VS te worden.
data.translatedTitle: “This is French,” Macron fulminates on French island in North America, after Trump includes the archipelago as part of the US
data.translatedDescription: French President Macron visited a tiny group of islands off the coast of Canada this weekend. On a map that US President Trump recently published, Saint-Pierre and Miquelon appeared to become part of the US.

data.title: ‘Vrouwen zijn altijd gereduceerd tot hun voortplantingsorganen. Eerst was het de baarmoeder, toen de eierstokken en nu zijn het de hormonen’
data.description: In de loop van de geschiedenis zijn er krankzinnige theorieën verkondigd over de overgang. Rina Knoeff schreef er een boek over. „We denken nu dat de overgang altijd taboe was, maar dat is niet waar.”
data.translatedTitle: 'Women have always been reduced to their reproductive organs. First it was the uterus, then the ovaries and now it's the hormones'
data.translatedDescription: Throughout history, crazy theories have been proclaimed about menopause. Rina Knoeff wrote a book about it. “We now think that the transition was always taboo, but that is not true.”

data.title: Hoofdrolspeler uit de documentaire Verstoten vaders wordt vervolgd wegens intieme terreur
data.description: De inmiddels voortvluchtige Armand S. werd in de documentaire Verstoten vaders als slachtoffer van ouderverstoting geportretteerd. Volgens justitie is hij schuldig aan jarenlang stalken en valsheid in geschrift.
data.translatedTitle: Lead actor from the documentary Rejected Fathers is prosecuted for intimate terror
data.translatedDescription: The now fugitive Armand S. was portrayed as a victim of parental alienation in the documentary Rejected Fathers. According to the judiciary, he is guilty of years of stalking and forgery.

data.title: Suikerzoete Disney, rauwe mime, grimmige maatschappijkritiek: jonge makers tonen hun talent in ‘Het Debuut’
data.description: Het is een gerespecteerde traditie: jaarlijks selecteert theaterbureau Via Rudolphi drie bijzondere afstudeervoorstellingen voor ‘Het Debuut’: één avond, drie korte optredens. De editie van 2026 demonstreert een welkome variëteit aan perspectieven en stijlen.
data.translatedTitle: Sugary sweet Disney, raw mime, grim social criticism: young makers show their talent in 'The Debut'
data.translatedDescription: It is a respected tradition: every year the Via Rudolphi theater agency selects three special graduation performances for 'Het Debuut': one evening, three short performances. The 2026 edition demonstrates a welcome variety of perspectives and styles.

data.title: Zelfs een muzikale allemansvriend lukt het niet om politiek te omzeilen: Ed Sheeran biedt excuses aan. ‘De wereld is momenteel een enge plek’
data.description: Popster Ed Sheeran kleurt muzikaal binnen de lijntjes en wist lange tijd controverses te omzeilen. Maar nadat rapper Macklemore uit zijn voorprogramma werd gezet, kreeg Sheeran een golf van kritiek over zich heen. Tijdens zijn eerste show na de ophef bood Sheeran in algemene zin zijn excuses aan.
data.translatedTitle: Even a musical friend of all people cannot avoid politics: Ed Sheeran apologizes. “The world is a scary place right now.”
data.translatedDescription: Pop star Ed Sheeran musically colors within the lines and has managed to avoid controversies for a long time. But after rapper Macklemore was kicked out of his supporting act, Sheeran was hit with a wave of criticism. During his first show after the controversy, Sheeran issued a general apology.

data.title: Trumps plan voor ‘AI force’ zet veiligheidstop met China onder druk
data.description: Donald Trump kondigt verdere versnelling aan van Amerikaanse AI-ontwikkeling. De stap leidt tot grote zorgen in China, precies op het moment dat de twee landen een top voorbereiden over AI-veiligheid.
data.translatedTitle: Trump's plan for 'AI force' puts pressure on security summit with China
data.translatedDescription: Donald Trump announces further acceleration of American AI development. The move is raising major concerns in China, just as the two countries prepare for a summit on AI safety.

data.title: In der erste Duma-Wahl seit dem Überfall auf die Ukraine lässt sich Putin seinen Kriegs-Kurs bestätigen
data.description: Die Regierungspartei Einiges Russland hat erneut eine überragende Mehrheit im Unterhaus des Parlaments errungen. Wichtiger als das vorhersehbare Ergebnis ist die Frage, was der Kreml nun als Nächstes vorhat.
data.translatedTitle: In the first Duma election since the attack on Ukraine, Putin has his war course confirmed
data.translatedDescription: The ruling party United Russia has once again won an overwhelming majority in the lower house of parliament. More important than the predictable outcome is the question of what the Kremlin plans to do next.

data.title: Granit Xhaka gibt zu, ein gefälschtes Covid-Zertifikat erworben zu haben – verliert der 33-Jährige jetzt die Captainbinde im Nationalteam?
data.description: Xhaka bestätigt, dass er sich nicht gegen das Coronavirus impfen liess. Die nächsten Länderspiele finden ohne den 33-Jährigen statt. Doch was danach mit ihm passiert, ist offen.
data.translatedTitle: Granit
data.translatedDescription: Xhaka confirms that he did not get vaccinated against the coronavirus. The next international matches will take place without the 33-year-old. But what happens to him afterwards remains unclear.

data.title: Die Cyberaffäre im Nachrichtendienst hat das Vertrauen der Mitarbeiter beschädigt – Hinweise auf politische Spionage gibt es aber keine
data.description: Eine neue Administrativuntersuchung zeigt, wie stark die Arbeit des NDB unter der Cyberaffäre gelitten hat. Der Vorwurf von SRF, dass es zu Spionage für Russland gekommen sei, entkräftet sie.
data.translatedTitle: The cyber affair in the intelligence service has damaged the trust of employees - but there is no evidence of political espionage
data.translatedDescription: A new administrative investigation shows how badly the NDB's work suffered as a result of the cyber affair. She refutes SRF's accusation that there was espionage for Russia.

data.title: Kühlen verboten: Wie die Baubürokratie Hauseigentümer weiter schwitzen lässt
data.description: Die Bewilligungspraxis für Klimaanlagen bleibt rigid. Und im Sommer sind die Geräte meist ausverkauft. Wer sein Haus im nächsten Sommer kühl halten will, sollte die Planung jetzt an die Hand nehmen.
data.translatedTitle: Cooling forbidden: How construction bureaucracy makes homeowners continue to sweat
data.translatedDescription: The approval practice for air conditioning systems remains rigid. And in summer the devices are usually sold out. If you want to keep your house cool next summer, you should start planning now.

data.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Vier Tote in der Region Kiew, darunter drei Kinder
data.description: Seit über vier Jahren führt Russland Krieg gegen die Ukraine. Die wichtigsten Entwicklungen im Überblick.
data.translatedTitle: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Four dead in the Kiev region, including three children
data.translatedDescription: Russia has been waging war against Ukraine for over four years. The most important developments at a glance.

data.title: Büchermachen als Dienst am Menschen: Die Zürcher Verlegerin Anne Rüffer ist mit 69 gestorben
data.description: Sie hatte ein Gespür für existenzielle Themen und suchte in ihren Büchern stets die «soziale Rendite».
data.translatedTitle: Making books as a service to people: The Zurich publisher Anne Rüffer died at the age of 69
data.translatedDescription: She had a feel for existential issues and always looked for “social returns” in her books.

data.title: Stillstand am Boden, Eskalation in der Luft – was gerade in der Ukraine passiert
data.description: Während an der Front Tausende für wenige Quadratkilometer Landgewinn sterben, brennen bei Moskau Lagerhäuser. Der Krieg verlagert sich und wird zugleich brutaler.
data.translatedTitle: Standstill on the ground, escalation in the air – what is currently happening in Ukraine
data.translatedDescription: While thousands die at the front for a few square kilometers of land, warehouses near Moscow are burning. The war is shifting and at the same time becoming more brutal.

data.title: KOMMENTAR - Jung, männlich, hoch motorisiert: Wer fahren lernt, braucht keine 500 PS
data.description: Die Zahl der Raserdelikte steigt. Die Politik schaute zu lange weg. Es braucht strengere Regeln für Junglenker und eine konsequentere Raserbekämpfung.
data.translatedTitle: COMMENT - Young, male, highly motorized: Anyone who learns to drive doesn't need 500 horsepower
data.translatedDescription: The number of speeding offenses is increasing. Politics looked the other way for too long. Stricter rules are needed for young drivers and more consistent combating of speeders.

data.title: Wie Donald Trump die Medikamentenpreise beim BAG mitbestimmt
data.description: Donald Trump will die hohen Medikamentenpreise in den USA drücken. Die Amerikaner sollen für neue Medikamente nicht mehr bezahlen als in anderen Ländern. Das hat Folgen für die Schweiz: Neue Therapien könnten teurer werden oder später erhältlich sein.
data.translatedTitle: How Donald Trump helps determine drug prices at the BAG
data.translatedDescription: Donald Trump wants to reduce high drug prices in the USA. Americans should not pay more for new drugs than in other countries. This has consequences for Switzerland: New therapies could become more expensive or become available later.

data.title: Anti-Chaoten-Initiative: Wer unbewilligt demonstriert, soll die Kosten selbst bezahlen müssen
data.description: In Zürich hat die SVP mit demselben Anliegen bereits vor zwei Jahren einen überraschenden Erfolg gefeiert. Das Problem: In Kraft ist die Regelung noch immer nicht.
data.translatedTitle: Anti-chaotic initiative: Anyone who demonstrates without permission should have to pay the costs themselves
data.translatedDescription: In Zurich, the SVP celebrated a surprising success with the same issue two years ago. The problem: The regulation is still not in force.

data.title: Spekulationen zu James Bond: Erst keine Zeit zu sterben, dann ganz viel Zeit zu grübeln
data.description: Welcher Schauspieler wird uns durch die nächsten Bond-Abenteuer führen? Einer Antwort auf diese Frage ist man in den vergangenen Tagen deutlich näher gekommen.
data.translatedTitle: Speculations about James Bond: First no time to die, then a lot of time to ponder
data.translatedDescription: Which actor will lead us through the next Bond adventures? An answer to this question has come much closer in the past few days.

data.title: Rom prescht vor: Italiens Marine soll Handelsschiffe vor Huthi-Angriffen schützen
data.description: Verteidigungsminister Guido Crosetto will nicht länger auf Europa warten. Nun hat er den Generalstab beauftragt, eine Militärmission in der Meerenge von Bab al-Mandab vorzubereiten.
data.translatedTitle: Rome is rushing forward: Italy's navy is supposed to protect merchant ships from Houthi attacks
data.translatedDescription: Defense Minister Guido Crosetto no longer wants to wait for Europe. He has now instructed the General Staff to prepare a military mission in the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

data.title: INTERVIEW - «Die Deutschschweiz hat verlernt zu geniessen» – warum ausgerechnet Gänseleber den Röstigraben vertieft
data.description: Eine Initiative will den Import von Stopfleber verbieten. Der frühere Nationalrat Josef Zisyadis hält dagegen und stellt eine grössere Frage: Hat die Deutschschweiz den Genuss dem korrekten Essen geopfert?
data.translatedTitle: INTERVIEW - “German-speaking Switzerland has forgotten how to enjoy” – why goose liver, of all things, deepens the Rösti ditch
data.translatedDescription: One initiative wants to ban the import of foie gras. Former National Councilor Josef Zisyadis counters this and asks a larger question: Has German-speaking Switzerland sacrificed enjoyment for correct eating?

data.title: EU-Verträge: Mit Mini-Job und Sozialhilfe zum Daueraufenthalt in der Schweiz? Im Ständerat gibt es Widerstand
data.description: EU-Bürger und ihre Familien können künftig nach fünf Jahren endgültig in der Schweiz bleiben – auch wenn sie nicht für sich selber aufkommen können. Bürgerliche Parlamentarier fordern höhere Hürden.
data.translatedTitle: EU treaties: With a mini-job and social assistance to permanent residence in Switzerland? There is resistance in the Council of States
data.translatedDescription: In the future, EU citizens and their families will be able to stay in Switzerland permanently after five years - even if they cannot support themselves. Citizen parliamentarians are demanding higher hurdles.

data.title: INTERVIEW - Ebola-Epidemie in Kongo-Kinshasa: «Der beste Impfstoff hilft nicht, wenn die Bevölkerung skeptisch ist»
data.description: Experten aus aller Welt warnen davor, dass es bald mehr als zehntausend Tote geben könnte. Der Zoonose-Experte Fabian Leendertz erläutert, was sich jetzt ändern müsste. Und betont, dass Ebola derzeit nur eines der Probleme der Bevölkerung sei.
data.translatedTitle: INTERVIEW - Ebola epidemic in Congo-Kinshasa: “The best vaccine doesn’t help if the population is skeptical”
data.translatedDescription: Experts from around the world warn that there could soon be more than ten thousand deaths. Zoonoses expert Fabian Leendertz explains what needs to change now. And emphasizes that Ebola is currently only one of the problems facing the population.

data.title: Teilweiser Hauseinsturz in Wiener City: Frau schwer verletzt
data.description: Die 57-Jährige stürzte aus dem dritten Stock ab und konnte erst nach Stunden befreit werden. Zwei weitere Personen wurden ebenfalls aus dem Haus geborgen.
data.translatedTitle: Partial house collapse in Vienna city: woman seriously injured
data.translatedDescription: The 57-year-old fell from the third floor and could only be freed after hours. Two other people were also rescued from the house.

data.title: „War stark verunsichert“: Schweizer Fußball-Star Xhaka gibt zu, Corona-Zertifikat gefälscht zu haben
data.description: Die „Nati“ genannte Schweizer Fußball-Nationalmannschaft muss wegen der Ermittlungen vier Spiele auf ihren Kapitän Granit Xhaka verzichten.
data.translatedTitle: “Was very unsettled”: Swiss soccer star Xhaka admits to forging Corona certificate
data.translatedDescription: The Swiss national football team, known as “Nati”, has to do without its captain Granit Xhaka for four games due to the investigation.

data.title: Minutenlang kopfüber: Fahrgeschäft auf Münchner Oktoberfest steckte fest
data.description: Auf dem Münchner Oktoberfest kam es auf dem „Predator“ zu einem Zwischenfall, die Fahrgäste konnten unverletzt geborgen werden. Über die Minuten des Stillstands machen Betreiber und Augenzeugen unterschiedliche Angaben
data.translatedTitle: Upside down for minutes: ride at Munich Oktoberfest got stuck
data.translatedDescription: There was an incident on the “Predator” at the Munich Oktoberfest and the passengers were rescued uninjured. Operators and eyewitnesses provide different information about the minutes of standstill

data.title: Wie sollen die neuen Euro-Banknoten aussehen? Umfrage endet
data.description: Nach 23 Jahren bekommen die Euro-Banknoten ein neues Design. Bereits neun Millionen Menschen haben abgestimmt. Am Montag endet die Umfrage.
data.translatedTitle: What should the new euro banknotes look like? Survey ends
data.translatedDescription: After 23 years, the euro banknotes are getting a new design. Nine million people have already voted. The survey ends on Monday.

data.title: Eine Wahl ohne Kontrolle: Putins Partei bejubelt Zweidrittelmehrheit im russischen Parlament
data.description: Nach vorläufigen Schätzungen komme die russische Regierungspartei mit Direktmandaten bisher auf 309 von 450 Sitzen in der Staatsduma. Das sind neun Mandate mehr als es zur Änderung der Verfassung braucht.
data.translatedTitle: An election without control: Putin's party celebrates two-thirds majority in the Russian parliament
data.translatedDescription: According to preliminary estimates, the Russian ruling party with direct mandates has so far won 309 of 450 seats in the State Duma. That is nine mandates more than it takes to change the constitution.

data.title: Verkehr durch Straße von Hormuz bricht ein
data.description: Vor Beginn des Krieges zwischen den USA, Israel und dem Iran am 28. Februar haben die Meerenge täglich etwa 125 große Handelsschiffe passiert.
data.translatedTitle: Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz collapses
data.translatedDescription: Before the war between the United States, Israel and Iran began on February 28, about 125 large merchant ships passed through the strait every day.

data.title: Sitzenbleiben nimmt in Österreich zu – schon in der Volksschule wiederholen viele
data.description: 18 Prozent der 15-Jährigen haben bereits mindestens eine Klasse wiederholt – 2012 waren es noch zwölf Prozent. Damit liegt Österreich deutlich über dem OECD-Schnitt.
data.translatedTitle: Sitting is on the rise in Austria - many people repeat it even in elementary school
data.translatedDescription: 18 percent of 15-year-olds have already repeated at least one grade – in 2012 the figure was twelve percent. This puts Austria well above the OECD average.

data.title: Cindy Crawfords Sohn Presley Gerber ist gestorben
data.description: Das 27-jährige Model starb in Los Angeles in einer Rehabilitationseinrichtung.
data.translatedTitle: Cindy Crawfords Sohn Presley Gerber ist gestorben
data.translatedDescription: The 27-year-old model died in a rehabilitation facility in Los Angeles.

data.title: Schimpftirade gegen Schiedsrichter: „Der alte Mourinho ist zurück“
data.description: Nach der Niederlade von Real Madrid gegen den Stadtrivalen Atletico kritisiert José Mourinho den Schiedsrichter. Er griff dabei auch auf ein altbekanntes Requisit zurück: Fotokopien, mit denen er die Fehler des Unparteiischen präsentierte.
data.translatedTitle: Rant against referees: “The old Mourinho is back”
data.translatedDescription: After Real Madrid's defeat against city rivals Atletico, José Mourinho criticized the referee. He also resorted to a well-known prop: photocopies with which he presented the referee's mistakes.

data.title: Personalrochade in Salzburg: Mayer löst Schnöll als Landeshauptfrau-Stellvertreter ab
data.description: Wolfgang Mayer, bisher schwarzer Klubobmann im Landtag, übernimmt die Ressorts Finanzen, Verkehr und Gesundheit.
data.translatedTitle: Personnel castling in Salzburg: Mayer replaces Schnöll as deputy governor
data.translatedDescription: Wolfgang Mayer, previously the black club chairman in the state parliament, will take over the finance, transport and health departments.

data.title: Anleger müssen sich für den Rest des Jahres auf einiges gefasst machen [premium]
data.description: Es gibt viele Dinge, die an der Börse heuer noch für Verunsicherung sorgen können. Wie sollten Anleger mit diesen potenziellen Gefahren umgehen?
data.translatedTitle: Investors have a lot to prepare for the rest of the year [premium]
data.translatedDescription: There are many things that could still cause uncertainty on the stock market this year. How should investors deal with these potential dangers?

data.title: Fünf Lehren aus den Wahlen in Berlin und Mecklenburg-Vorpommern [premium]
data.description: Friedrich Merz will bis auf Abruf als Reformkanzler weitermachen. Die SPD hat ihre Personalreserve schon gefunden. Dank der Schwäche der Koalition wachsen die Ränder links wie rechts. Die AfD kann ihren Sieg im Nordosten nicht umsetzen. Und auch die Linke droht in Berlin am Realitätstest zu scheitern.
data.translatedTitle: Five lessons from the elections in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania [premium]
data.translatedDescription: Friedrich Merz wants to continue as reform chancellor until called upon. The SPD has already found its personnel reserve. Thanks to the coalition's weakness, the margins on both the left and the right are growing. The AfD cannot implement its victory in the northeast. And the Left also threatens to fail the reality test in Berlin.

data.title: Wahldebakel: Übersteht Friedrich Merz den Montag als CDU-Parteichef und deutscher Kanzler?
data.description: CDU-Parteichef und deutscher Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz berät am Montag mit seiner Partei. Bei den Sitzungen wird sich zeigen, ob die CDU-Führung hinter Kanzler steht. Nicht nur die Opposition hat ihn längst angezählt.
data.translatedTitle: Election debacle: Will Friedrich Merz survive Monday as CDU party leader and German Chancellor?
data.translatedDescription: CDU party leader and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz will discuss with his party on Monday. The meetings will show whether the CDU leadership is behind the Chancellor. It's not just the opposition that has counted him out for a long time.

data.title: CDU erlitt eine historische Schmach, AfD und Linke auf Platz eins: Die Radikalen sind im Aufwind [premium]
