data.translatedTitle: Father's sisters Jankowski won the trial for her brother's good memory. There will be a cassation
data.translatedDescription: The trial for the protection of personal rights concerned the text of "Gazeta Wyborcza", which accused Fr. Jankowski, sexual abuse of children in the years 1967-1970. "Rzeczpospolita" once won a lawsuit over another article against a controversial priest.

data.title: W Polsce ma stacjonować 15 tysięcy żołnierzy USA. Ale nie przed 2030 rokiem
data.description: W stałej bazie wojsk USA, która miałaby powstać w Polsce, stacjonowałoby ok. 4-5 tysięcy żołnierzy - wynika ze słów wiceministra obrony narodowej Stanisława Wziątka.
data.translatedTitle: 15,000 US soldiers are to be stationed in Poland. But not before 2030
data.translatedDescription: Approximately 4-5 thousand soldiers would be stationed in the permanent US military base that would be established in Poland - according to the words of the Deputy Minister of National Defense Stanisław Wziątek.

data.title: Polak nie chciał oceniać występów Rosjan i wyrzucono go z jury. Teraz zabiera głos
data.description: – Nie mogłem podjąć innej decyzji – mówi „Rzeczpospolitej” wybitny instrumentalista prof. Klaudiusz Baran, który odmówił oceny rosyjskich wykonawców podczas konkursu we włoskim Castelfidardo. Włosi chcą go ukarać wykluczeniem z przyszłych składów jurorskich, za to swojego wykładowcy broni Uniwersytet Muzyczny Fryderyka Chopina.
data.translatedTitle: The Pole did not want to evaluate the Russians' performances and was thrown out of the jury. Now he's speaking out
data.translatedDescription: – I couldn't make a different decision – says "Rzeczpospolita", an outstanding instrumentalist, prof. Klaudiusz Baran, who refused to evaluate Russian performers during the competition in Castelfidardo, Italy. The Italians want to punish him by excluding him from future juries, but the Fryderyk Chopin University of Music defends its lecturer.

data.title: Złoty niewzruszony po cięciu ratingu przez Moody's
data.description: Decyzja nie była spodziewana przez ekonomistów, ale rynek nie wydaje się być nią mocno zaskoczony.
data.translatedTitle: The zloty remains unmoved after the rating cut by Moody's
data.translatedDescription: The decision was not expected by economists, but the market does not seem to be very surprised by it.

data.title: Były ukryte przez 100 lat. Odsłonili oryginalne wnętrza kamienicy Gaudíego
data.description: W słynnej kamienicy Casa Batlló w Barcelonie udostępniono piętro, którego do tej pory nie można było zwiedzać. Przez ponad sto lat pozostawało niedostępne, teraz to przestrzeń do wynajęcia.
data.translatedTitle: They were hidden for 100 years. They unveiled the original interior of Gaudí's tenement house
data.translatedDescription: In the famous Casa Batlló tenement house in Barcelona, ​​a floor that has not been open to the public until now has been opened. It remained unavailable for over a hundred years, now it is a space for rent.

data.title: Uganda zawiesza współpracę wojskową z Turcją. Kłótnia o blogera
data.description: Spór o ekstradycję Freda Lumbuyego, blogera i krytyka prezydenta Ugandy Yoweriego Museveniego, doprowadził do zawieszenia współpracy wojskowej między Turcją a Ugandą.
data.translatedTitle: Uganda suspends military cooperation with Turkey. Argument over a blogger
data.translatedDescription: The dispute over the extradition of Fred Lumbuy, a blogger and critic of Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni, has led to the suspension of military cooperation between Turkey and Uganda.

data.title: Mecenat kultury to inwestycja na lata. Totalizator Sportowy wesprze Operę Narodową
data.description: Wspieranie kultury i ochrona dziedzictwa wymagają nie tylko pieniędzy, ale przede wszystkim długofalowego zaangażowania. Totalizator Sportowy został Mecenasem Teatru Wielkiego – Opery Narodowej. Współpraca została zaplanowana na cztery lata.
data.translatedTitle: Patronage of culture is an investment for years. Totalizator Sportowy will support the National Opera
data.translatedDescription: Supporting culture and protecting heritage requires not only money, but above all long-term commitment. Totalizator Sportowy became the Patron of the Grand Theater - National Opera. The cooperation was planned for four years.

data.title: Europa szuka swojego miejsca w nowym układzie sił
data.description: Rosnąca potęga Chin i Indii, oczekiwania globalnego Południa, wojna w Ukrainie i napięcia na Bliskim Wschodzie zmieniają warunki, w których działa europejska gospodarka. Jak w tej rzeczywistości Unia Europejska może odbudować konkurencyjność i wzmocnić swoją pozycję? O tym będą rozmawiać uczestnicy Europejskiego Forum Nowych Idei.
data.translatedTitle: Europe is looking for its place in the new balance of power
data.translatedDescription: The growing power of China and India, the expectations of the global South, the war in Ukraine and tensions in the Middle East are changing the conditions in which the European economy operates. In this reality, how can the European Union rebuild competitiveness and strengthen its position? This is what the participants of the European Forum for New Ideas will talk about.

data.title: Ćwierć miliona za obraz do Sejmu. Włodzimierz Czarzasty pokaże go dopiero za kilka lat
data.description: Marszałek Czarzasty kupił za pieniądze Sejmu portret idola Lewicy. Obraz Witkacego przedstawiający Ignacego Daszyńskiego kosztował ok. 276 tys. zł. Publiczność zobaczy go dopiero za kilka lat w planowanym Parlamentarium, a już dziś zakup budzi mieszane uczucia wśród posłów.
data.translatedTitle: A quarter of a million for a painting for the Sejm. Włodzimierz Czarzasty will show it only in a few years
data.translatedDescription: Marshal Czarzasty bought a portrait of the idol of the Left with money from the Sejm. Witkacy's painting depicting Ignacy Daszyński cost approximately PLN 276,000. zloty. The public will see it only in a few years in the planned Parliamentarium, and today the purchase raises mixed feelings among MPs.

data.title: Ekspansja zagraniczna po polsku, czyli jak osiągnąć sukces
data.description: W dobie nasycenia rodzimego rynku i rosnącej presji konkurencyjnej, wyjście poza granice kraju przestaje być dla polskich przedsiębiorstw jedynie opcją, a staje się strategiczną koniecznością. Jednak sukces na arenie międzynarodowej to proces znacznie bardziej złożony niż prosta replikacja krajowego modelu biznesowego - ocenili uczestnicy kolejnego CFO Roundtable „Rzeczpospolitej”, spotkania zorganizowanego przy okazji konkursu CFO Excellence Awards.
data.translatedTitle: Foreign expansion in Polish, or how to achieve success
data.translatedDescription: In times of saturation of the domestic market and growing competitive pressure, going beyond the country's borders is no longer just an option for Polish enterprises, but is becoming a strategic necessity. However, success in the international arena is a much more complex process than simple replication of the domestic business model - said the participants of the next CFO Roundtable of "Rzeczpospolita", a meeting organized on the occasion of the CFO Excellence Awards competition.

data.title: Další krok pro metro D. Dopravní podnik získal stavební povolení na stanici Libuš
data.description: Pražský dopravní podnik (DPP) získal zatím nepravomocné stavební povolení na další úsek budované linky metra D, který bude spočívat ve výstavbě stanice metra Libuš. Informace se objevila na stránkách Dopravního a energetického stavebního úřadu (DESÚ) a potvrdil to mluvčí podniku Daniel Šabík.
data.translatedTitle: The next step for metro D. The transport company received a building permit for the Libuš station
data.translatedDescription: The Prague Transport Company (DPP) has so far obtained a non-authorized building permit for the next section of the D metro line under construction, which will consist of the construction of the Libuš metro station. The information appeared on the website of the Transport and Energy Construction Office (DESÚ) and was confirmed by the company's spokesperson Daniel Šabík.

data.title: Jeden z nejhorších týdnů vůbec. Po vlně protestů se Sheeran na koncertě rozplakal
data.description: Zpěvák Ed Sheeran se ocitl mezi dvěma ohni. Kvůli ostrému projevu na podporu Palestiny odvolali z turné jeho předskokana rapera Macklemora, protože urazil židovskou komunitu. To ovšem rozlítilo propalestinské fanoušky a Sheerana opustila i kapela. Zpěvák chtěl udržet koncerty bez politických proklamací. Nakonec se ale sám ke Gaze musel vyjádřit a z bezpečnostních důvodů i změnit dramaturgii.
data.translatedTitle: One of the worst weeks ever. After a wave of protests, Sheeran broke down in tears at the concert
data.translatedDescription: Singer Ed Sheeran found himself between two fires. His frontman, rapper Macklemore, was pulled from the tour for a harsh speech in support of Palestine because he insulted the Jewish community. However, this angered the pro-Palestinian fans and Sheeran left the band as well. The singer wanted to keep the concerts free of political proclamations. In the end, however, he had to comment on Gaza himself and, for security reasons, also change the dramaturgy.

data.title: Jednotné Rusko míří k rekordnímu volebnímu výsledku. Opozici předem vyloučili
data.description: První parlamentní volby, které se v Rusku konaly během války proti Ukrajině, ovládla vládnoucí strana Jednotné Rusko. Vyplývá to z výsledků po sečtení více než 95 procent hlasů. Agentura AFP píše, že jde o dosavadní rekord této strany, která politický život v Rusku ovládá více než 20 let. Reálná opozice byla z voleb vyloučena.
data.translatedTitle: United Russia is headed for a record election result. They excluded the opposition in advance
data.translatedDescription: The first parliamentary elections held in Russia during the war against Ukraine were won by the ruling United Russia party. It follows from the results after counting more than 95 percent of the votes. The AFP agency writes that this is the current record of this party, which has dominated political life in Russia for more than 20 years. The real opposition was excluded from the elections.

data.title: Vláda schvaluje návrh státního rozpočtu, projedná opatření proti drahým palivům
data.description: Návrh státního rozpočtu na příští rok schvaluje vláda Andreje Babiše. Původně ministryně financí za ANO Alena Schillerová navrhla schodek 389 miliard korun, což se zdálo vysoké i koaličním partnerům ANO – Motoristům sobě i SPD. Koalice se domluvila, že do Sněmovny pošle návrh se schodkem nižším o jednotky miliard.
data.translatedTitle: The government approves the draft state budget, discusses measures against expensive fuels
data.translatedDescription: The draft state budget for next year is approved by the government of Andrej Babiš. Originally, the Minister of Finance for ANO, Alena Schillerová, proposed a deficit of 389 billion crowns, which seemed high even to the coalition partners of ANO – Motoristům and the SPD. The coalition agreed to send a proposal to the House of Representatives with a deficit lower by billion units.

data.title: „Když na kruháči potkáš letadlo.“ Letoun bez křídel zdolal křižovatku, řidiči se divili
data.description: Řidiči v Lánově na Trutnovsku s údivem sledovali, jak po zdejší rušné silnici v běžném provozu projíždí malé letadlo bez křídel. S točící se vrtulí zdolalo kruhový objezd a mířilo nejspíš k nedalekému vrchlabskému letišti. Video se teď šíří po sociálních sítích.
data.translatedTitle: "When you meet a plane on the roundabout." A plane without wings conquered the intersection, the drivers were amazed
data.translatedDescription: Drivers in Lánov in Trutnovsk watched with astonishment as a small plane without wings passed through the local busy road in normal traffic. With the spinning propeller, it overcame the roundabout and was probably headed for the nearby Vrchlab airport. The video is now going viral on social media.

data.title: Teplárny v Česku zahajují topnou sezonu, v podobném termínu jako loni
data.description: Teplárny v Česku reagují na výrazný pokles teplot v tomto týdnu, kdy budou na většině území splněny podmínky pro zahájení vytápění, a zahajují topnou sezonu. Termín je podobný jako vloni a odpovídá průměru z posledních zhruba 15 let, informovalo Teplárenské sdružení. Uplynulá topná sezona byla intenzivnější než v předchozích letech, meziročně byla chladnější o 4,9 procenta.
data.translatedTitle: Heating plants in the Czech Republic are starting the heating season, on a similar date as last year
data.translatedDescription: Heating plants in the Czech Republic are reacting to a significant drop in temperatures this week, when the conditions for starting heating will be met in most areas, and are starting the heating season. The term is similar to last year and corresponds to the average of the last 15 years, the Heating Association informed. The past heating season was more intense than in previous years, it was cooler by 4.9 percent year-on-year.

data.title: GLOSA: Fico je pacifista mamánek, ruské peníze mu nesmrdí, píše ukrajinský analytik
data.description: Robert Fico se o víkendu postaral o pořádný rozruch, když zpochybnil železné pravidlo kolektivní obrany NATO. Jeho slova zkritizovali český i slovenský prezident a všimli si jich i na Ukrajině. „Otázka je, zda může Slovensko dnes stále počítat s ochranou ze strany NATO. Fico možná cítí, že to není tak jednoznačné. A proto podlézá Putinovi,“ píše ukrajinský ekonom a komentátor Serhij Fursa.
data.translatedTitle: GLOSA: Fico is a pacifist, he doesn't like Russian money, writes a Ukrainian analyst
data.translatedDescription: Robert Fico caused quite a stir at the weekend when he questioned NATO's ironclad rule of collective defence. His words were criticized by the Czech and Slovak presidents and were also noticed in Ukraine. "The question is whether Slovakia can still count on NATO protection today. Fico may feel that it is not so clear-cut. That is why he is subservient to Putin," writes Ukrainian economist and commentator Serhij Fursa.

data.title: Spory s manželkou řešil muž žhářstvím, pak se sám přijel udat policistům
data.description: Dům, který patří jeho manželce, s níž už ovšem nežije, se pokusil zapálit šestačtyřicetiletý muž na Karlovarsku. Jen shodou okolností při požáru, který založil, nikdo neutrpěl zranění, oheň se sousedům podařilo uhasit. Muž posílený alkoholem se po činu přijel sám udat policistům.
data.translatedTitle: The man resolved disputes with his wife by arson, then came to report himself to the police
data.translatedDescription: A forty-six-year-old man tried to set fire to the house that belongs to his wife, with whom he no longer lives. Only by coincidence, no one was injured in the fire he started, the neighbors managed to extinguish the fire. The man, strengthened by alcohol, came to report himself to the police after the crime.

data.title: Serial Killer zahájí Prušinovského Oddíl B, festival uvede pětici českých novinek
data.description: Rovnou pětici nových českých seriálů uvede mezinárodní festival Serial Killer, který se v Brně uskuteční od středy do příštího pondělí. Česká tvorba má letos mimořádně silnou sezonu, a proto se pořadatelé rozhodli podívat důkladněji domů. V nové soutěžní sekci Czech Killer se tak představí pět novinek.
data.translatedTitle: Serial Killer will open Prušinovský's Section B, the festival will present five Czech novelties
data.translatedDescription: Five new Czech serials will be presented by the Serial Killer international festival, which will take place in Brno from Wednesday to next Monday. Czech creation has an exceptionally strong season this year, which is why the organizers decided to take a closer look at home. Five novelties will thus be presented in the new Czech Killer competition section.

data.title: Zbabělec, lhář, reagují slovenská média na Ficovy výroky o závazcích NATO
data.description: Slovenská média houfně reagují na výroky premiéra Roberta Fica o závazcích své země vůči NATO a možné válce s Ruskem. Část deníků mu vyčítá zpochybnění kolektivní obrany podle aliančního článku pět, jiné jeho slova spojují se snahou oslovit radikálnější část voličů. „Fico je zbabělec a lhář. Zrádce,“ napsal například Denník N.
data.translatedTitle: Coward, liar, Slovak media react to Fico's statements about NATO commitments
data.translatedDescription: The Slovak media are reacting in droves to Prime Minister Robert Fico's statements about his country's commitments to NATO and a possible war with Russia. Some of the newspapers blame him for questioning the collective defense according to alliance article five, others associate his words with an attempt to reach a more radical part of the electorate. "Fico is a coward and a liar. A traitor," Denník N wrote, for example.

data.title: Dva mocné hlasy. V nové brněnské T Areně vystoupí José Carreras a Plácido Domingo
data.description: Dvě z nejvýznamnějších osobností světové opery, José Carreras a Plácido Domingo, vystoupí společně poprvé v Brně. Legendární pěvci, kteří spolu s Lucianem Pavarottim proslavili operu po celém světě díky nezapomenutelným koncertům Tří tenorů, se představí 20. ledna příštího roku v nově otevřené T Areně.
data.translatedTitle: Two powerful voices. José Carreras and Plácido Domingo will perform in the new T Arena in Brno
data.translatedDescription: Two of the most important personalities of world opera, José Carreras and Plácido Domingo, will perform together for the first time in Brno. The legendary singers, who together with Luciano Pavarotti made opera famous all over the world thanks to the unforgettable concerts of the Three Tenors, will perform on January 20 next year in the newly opened T Arena.

data.title: I dítěti ze skromných poměrů můžete do osmnácti našetřit milion, říkají experti
data.description: Milion korun při vstupu do dospělosti nemusí být jen výsadou dětí bohatých rodičů. Podle Jany Brodani z Asociace pro kapitálový trh, zakladatele Portu Radima Krejčího a ambasadora finanční gramotnosti Ekonomického ústavu Akademie věd Lukáše Nádvorníka je důležitější než vysoké vklady začít včas a vydržet. V pořadu iDNES Lounge vysvětlují, proč dětem hraje do karet dlouhý investiční horizont a proč samotný spořicí účet nemusí stačit.
data.translatedTitle: Even a child from a modest background can save a million by the time he turns eighteen, experts say
data.translatedDescription: A million crowns upon entering adulthood is not only the privilege of children of rich parents. According to Jana Brodani from the Capital Market Association, Port founder Radim Krejčí and Lukáš Nádvorník, financial literacy ambassador of the Academy of Sciences' Institute of Economics, it is more important than high deposits to start on time and last. In the program iDNES Lounge, they explain why a long investment horizon plays into the cards for children and why a savings account alone may not be enough.

ner.entity: Academy of Sciences' Institute of Economics
ner.label: ORG

data.title: Za koně ze Španělska zaplatila žena z Vysočiny 3 000 eur, zvířete se nedočkala
data.description: Že je možné stát se obětí podvodu i při koupi živého zvířete, se přesvědčila žena z Přibyslavi na Havlíčkobrodsku. Ve Španělsku si vyhlédla koně, vyřídila doklady a přepravu, zaplatila za něj tři tisíce eur, ale zvířete se nedočkala.
data.translatedTitle: A woman from Vysočina paid 3,000 euros for a horse from Spain, she did not receive the animal
data.translatedDescription: A woman from Přibyslav in the Havlíčkobrod region was convinced that it is possible to become a victim of fraud even when buying a live animal. She looked for a horse in Spain, arranged the documents and transport, paid three thousand euros for it, but did not receive the animal.

data.title: Plzeň má drahé jízdné, deset obvodů nepotřebujeme, tvrdí lídr Motoristů
data.description: Byl starostou městského obvodu Plzeň 4 za ODS, následoval post místopředsedy antimonopolního úřadu, byl i zmocněncem státu pro gigafactory v Líních u Plzně. Dnes je Hynek Brom členem strany Motoristé a lídrem její kandidátky do nadcházejících komunálních voleb v Plzni. Jeho mottem, s nímž jde do voleb, je šetření a zefektivnění samosprávy. „Skutečně v Plzni potřebujeme 10 městských obvodů, když mají minimální kompetence?“ ptá se lídr.
data.translatedTitle: Pilsen has expensive fares, we don't need ten districts, claims the leader of Motorists
data.translatedDescription: He was the mayor of the Pilsen 4 municipal district for the ODS, followed by the post of vice-chairman of the antimonopoly office, and was also the state representative for the gigafactory in Línich near Pilsen. Today, Hynek Brom is a member of the Motorists party and the leader of its candidate for the upcoming municipal elections in Pilsen. His motto, with which he is going to the elections, is to investigate and make self-government more efficient. "Do we really need 10 city districts in Pilsen when they have minimal competence?" the leader asks.

data.title: Nemůžeš napsat něco normálního? Nové písně Kvietah překvapily i její spoluhráče
data.description: Písničkářka Magdalena Fendrychová vystupující jako Kvietah na třetím albu Rozkousanej svět propojuje intimní výpovědi s reakcemi na současné dění. V rozhovoru mluví o společné tvorbě s kapelou Včely, svém přístupu k psaní písní i zkušenosti s potratem, kterou zpracovala ve starší skladbě Díky, včely.
data.translatedTitle: Can't you write something normal? Kvietah's new songs surprised even her teammates
data.translatedDescription: Singer Magdalena Fendrychová, performing as Kvietah on her third album Rozkousanej svet, connects intimate statements with reactions to current events. In the interview, she talks about working together with the band Včely, her approach to songwriting, and her experience with abortion, which she covered in the older composition Thanks, bees.

data.title: Na zubní pohotovosti ohrožoval zbraní zdravotníka, mladíka hledá policie
data.description: Českobudějovičtí policisté pátrají po mladíkovi, který na  zubní pohotovosti zbraní ohrožoval zdravotnický personál. Nikomu neublížil a odešel. Policii se ho zatím nepodařilo najít, žádá proto o pomoc veřejnost.
data.translatedTitle: He threatened a paramedic with a gun at the dental emergency, the police are looking for the young man
data.translatedDescription: České Budějovice police officers are searching for a young man who threatened medical staff with a weapon at the dental emergency. He didn't hurt anyone and left. The police have not been able to find him yet, so they are asking for the public's help.

data.title: Mladí potřebují bydlení a město nějakou vizi, shodují se lídři v Šumperku
data.description: Demografický vývoj patří k největším problémům, kterým čelí Šumperk. Zatímco na začátku tisíciletí měl více než 29 tisíc obyvatel, na konci loňského roku jich bylo už jen přes 24 tisíc, město tak přišlo téměř o pětinu obyvatel. A populace stárne. Není proto překvapivé, že jedním z nejsilnějších témat předvolební ankety iDNES.cz je bydlení.
data.translatedTitle: Young people need housing and the city needs a vision, the leaders in Šumperk agree
data.translatedDescription: Demographic development is one of the biggest problems facing Šumperk. While at the beginning of the millennium it had more than 29,000 inhabitants, at the end of last year there were only over 24,000, the city thus lost almost a fifth of its inhabitants. And the population is aging. It is therefore not surprising that one of the strongest topics in the iDNES.cz pre-election survey is housing.

data.title: Končí autobusová linka přes Waltrovku, její provoz plně přebírají nové trolejbusy
data.description: Od pondělí už nejezdí autobusy z Knížecí přes Waltrovku na Jinonice. Plně je totiž nahrazují trolejbusy. Mění se také číslo linky z 137 na novou 52.
data.translatedTitle: The bus line through Waltrovka ends, its operation is fully taken over by new trolleybuses
data.translatedDescription: From Monday, buses from Knížecí via Waltrovka to Jinonice no longer run. They are completely replaced by trolleybuses. The line number is also changing from 137 to the new 52.

data.title: Překvapení roku. Šéf Škody skončí, půjde vládnout Volvu
data.description: Automobilka Volvo jmenovala Klause Zellmera na pozici generálního ředitele. Aktuální šéf Škody Auto se do roka stane prezidentem a generálním ředitelem švédské značky a nahradí tak Håkana Samuelssona. Zellmer nastoupí do své funkce nejpozději 1. října 2027.
data.translatedTitle: Surprise of the year. The boss of Škoda will quit, he will go to rule Volvo
data.translatedDescription: Volvo has appointed Klaus Zellmer as CEO. The current head of Škoda Auto will become president and CEO of the Swedish brand within a year, replacing Håkan Samuelsson. Zellmer will take office no later than October 1, 2027.

data.title: NKÚ kritizuje podporu zemědělského výzkumu. Ministerstvo nesleduje jeho přínosy
data.description: Ministerstvo zemědělství vynaložilo v letech 2017 až 2025 celkem 3,3 miliardy korun na podporu aplikovaného výzkumu v zemědělství. Nedokáže ale vyhodnotit, jestli mají podpořené projekty skutečné dopady v praxi a jaké tyto dopady jsou. Zjistil to Nejvyšší kontrolní úřad (NKÚ) při kontrole peněz vynakládaných ministerstvem na podporu aplikovaného výzkumu. Kontrolní úřad doporučuje změnit systém podpory tak, aby výsledky projektů prokazatelně sloužily zemědělské praxi, stojí ve zprávě NKÚ. Resort se závěry kontroly nesouhlasí.
data.translatedTitle: The SAO criticizes the support of agricultural research. The Ministry does not track its benefits
data.translatedDescription: Between 2017 and 2025, the Ministry of Agriculture spent a total of 3.3 billion crowns to support applied research in agriculture. However, it cannot evaluate whether the supported projects have real impacts in practice and what these impacts are. This was discovered by the Supreme Audit Office (NAO) during an inspection of the money spent by the ministry to support applied research. The control office recommends changing the support system so that the results of the projects demonstrably serve agricultural practice, says the report of the SAO. The resort does not agree with the conclusions of the inspection.

data.title: Levice ovládla Berlín, AfD Meklenbursko. CDU poprvé vypadla ze zemského sněmu
data.description: Volby v Berlíně a Meklenbursku-Předním Pomořansku přinesly výrazný posun na německé politické scéně. V hlavním městě zvítězila Levice, která by podle projekce mohla sestavit vládu se Zelenými a SPD, zatímco v Meklenbursku-Předním Pomořansku získala nejvíce hlasů AfD. CDU tam s 4,9 procenta poprvé v historii nepřekročila pětiprocentní hranici.
data.translatedTitle: The Left took control of Berlin, AfD Mecklenburg. For the first time, the CDU fell out of the Land Assembly
data.translatedDescription: The elections in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern brought about a significant shift in the German political scene. The Left won in the capital, which according to the projection could form a government with the Greens and the SPD, while in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern the AfD won the most votes. There, with 4.9 percent, the CDU did not exceed the five percent threshold for the first time in its history.

data.title: Přelomový rozsudek v Norimberku. Za zranění na ferratě nesou odpovědnost sami lezci
data.description: Soud v bavorském Norimberku rozhodl, že za zranění na zajištěné cestě, takzvané ferratě, nesou odpovědnost sami lezci, protože na trasu vstupují na vlastní nebezpečí. Informoval o tom portál bavorské veřejnoprávní stanice Bayerischer Rundfunk (BR). Verdikt je považován za přelomový, protože dosud odpovědnost za podobné úrazy připadala vlastníkům či provozovatelům. Z obav před možnými zraněními proto řada majitelů lesů v Bavorsku znepřístupnila skalní vyhlídky a z lesů nechala odstranit také lavičky.
data.translatedTitle: The landmark verdict in Nuremberg. Climbers themselves are responsible for injuries on the via ferrata
data.translatedDescription: The court in Nuremberg, Bavaria, ruled that the climbers themselves are responsible for injuries on a secured route, the so-called via ferrata, because they enter the route at their own risk. This was reported by the portal of the Bavarian public broadcaster Bayerischer Rundfunk (BR). The verdict is considered ground-breaking, because until now the responsibility for similar accidents fell to the owners or operators. For fear of possible injuries, a number of forest owners in Bavaria have therefore made rock viewpoints inaccessible and have also had benches removed from the forests.

data.title: Israeli forces strike former Assad military sites on Mount Hermon: Syrian state media

Israeli forces also shelled an area southeast of Al-Rafid, a town in the southern Quneitra countryside, Alikhbariah TV said. data.title: US arrests 18 suspects in killing of Haitian president
data.description: Eighteen suspects have been extradited to Florida to stand trial for the 2021 assassination of Haitian President Jovenel Moise, as part of ongoing efforts by U.S. authorities to bring all involved in the plot to justice. This follows a series of indictments and convictions related to the killing, which has contributed to escalating chaos in Haiti, where gangs control much of the capital and elections are imminent.

data.title: Cameroun/ Enseignement supérieur : le Minesup annonce des paiements, le Synes maintient la grève
data.description: © DR Au lendemain du communiqué du ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur annonçant l'apurement des primes de recherche, le Syndicat national des enseignants du supérieur (SYNES) a décidé de maintenir son mot d'ordre de grève illimitée tout en saluant les progrès. Le dialogue a repris, mais la crise persiste. Dans son communiqué n° 26 du 18 septembre 2026, le ministre d'Etat Jacques Fame Ndongo annonce des avancées financières concrètes, sur instructions du chef de l'Etat. Pour le 4e trimestre 2025, 5 478 395 000 FCFA ont été intégralement payés le 26 juillet 2026 par virement. Pour le1er trimestre 2026 le reliquat de 1 769 475 000 FCFA a été payé le 18 septembre 2026. Cumul du trimestre : 4 861 540 000 FCFA. Pour le 2e trimestre 2026, 4 919 725 000 FCFA sont disponibles. Les paiements par virement ont débuté le 18 septembre et par billetage à partir du 23 septembre à l'Agence comptable du ministère. Pour ce qui est de la dette académique (2000-2021), sur 16,959 milliards FCFA, 7,294 milliards déjà payés (43%). Il reste 9,696 milliards à apurer selon la trésorerie. Le Ministre compte sur "la maturité des enseignants pour la poursuite sereine des activités dans un climat apaisé". Mais, le syndicat semble comprendre sans toutefois céder. Les conclusions du SYNES : le dialogue salué, mais pas suffisant Réuni en session extraordinaire le 20 septembre par visioconférence, le Bureau exécutif national du Synes a rendu ses conclusions. Le syndicat salue le renouement du dialogue, première concertation depuis le lancement de la grève le 03 septembre 2026, avec la présence du ministère des finances, et prend acte des paiements du quatrième trimestre 2025 et du premier trimestre 2026. Mais pour le Synes, le consensus n'est pas atteint. Le syndicat pointe deux blocages : l'intégralité du 2e trimestre 2026 n'est pas encore garantie. L'absence de la liste consolidée et transparente de la dette académique. Par conséquent, le Synes maintient le mot d'ordre de grève illimitée, qui se traduit par la suspension de toutes les activités académiques, y compris les soutenances de Master et Doctorat, en attendant "des avancées obtenues". C'est donc un statu quo : le Minesup affiche des décaissements records pour désamorcer la crise, le Synes exige des garanties écrites et traçables avant de lever la grève. Cet article Cameroun/ Enseignement supérieur : le Minesup annonce des paiements, le Synes maintient la grève est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Cameroon/ Higher education: Minesup announces payments, Synes maintains strike
data.translatedDescription: © DR Following the press release from the Ministry of Higher Education announcing the clearance of research bonuses, the National Union of Higher Education Teachers (SYNES) decided to maintain its slogan of an indefinite strike while welcoming the progress. The dialogue has resumed, but the crisis persists. In his press release No. 26 of September 18, 2026, Minister of State Jacques Fame Ndongo announces concrete financial advances, on instructions from the Head of State. For the 4th quarter of 2025, 5,478,395,000 FCFA were paid in full on July 26, 2026 by transfer. For the first quarter of 2026, the balance of 1,769,475,000 FCFA was paid on September 18, 2026. Total for the quarter: 4,861,540,000 FCFA. For the 2nd quarter of 2026, 4,919,725,000 FCFA are available. Payments by transfer began on September 18 and by ticketing from September 23 to the Ministry's Accounting Agency. As for the academic debt (2000-2021), out of 16.959 billion FCFA, 7.294 billion already paid (43%). There remains 9.696 billion to be cleared according to the treasury. The Minister is counting on “the maturity of teachers for the peaceful pursuit of activities in a peaceful climate”. But the union seems to understand without giving in. The conclusions of SYNES: the dialogue welcomed, but not sufficient Meeting in extraordinary session on September 20 by videoconference, the National Executive Office of Synes delivered its conclusions. The union welcomes the resumption of dialogue, the first consultation since the launch of the strike on September 3, 2026, with the presence of the Ministry of Finance, and takes note of the payments for the fourth quarter of 2025 and the first quarter of 2026. But for Synes, consensus has not been reached. The union points to two blockages: the entire 2nd quarter of 2026 is not yet guaranteed. The absence of the consolidated and transparent list of academic debt. Consequently, Synes maintains the slogan of unlimited strike, which translates into the suspension of all academic activities, including Master's and Doctorate defenses, pending "progress achieved". It is therefore a status quo: Minesup is posting record disbursements to defuse the crisis, Synes is demanding written and traceable guarantees before calling off the strike. This article Cameroon/Higher education: Minesup announces payments, Synes maintains strike appeared first on Journalducameroun.com.

data.title: Cameroun : le Pr Aba’a Oyono annonce son intention de se présenter aux élections municipales et législatives
data.description: © DR L'universitaire et critique rigide du régime exprime sa volonté de se lancer à la conquête des suffrages lors des prochaines élections locales et parlementaires. C'est une surprise venant de celui qui refuse des postes de recteur ou de ministre sous le régime actuel. Parce que, dit-il, des conditions ne sont pas réunies. Le Pr Jean Calvin Aba'a Oyono veut se lancer à la course pour le pouvoir en commençant par la base, puis le niveau intermédiaire. L'opposant au régime de Yaoundé a annoncé dimanche à l'émission L'Arène sur la chaîne Canal 2 international qu'il s'apprête à se présenter aux prochaines élections. À l'écoute du politique, deux paramètres entrent en jeu. Le premier concerne le parti politique sous la bannière duquel il va se présenter. Le deuxième est la circonscription électorale. Par rapport au parti politique, Aba'a Oyono a soutenu ces derniers temps deux leaders politiques. Maurice Kamto du MRC puis du Manidem lors de la présidentielle et Issa Tchiroma Bakary du Fsnc. Les deux partis politiques sont ceux qui peuvent a priori accorder l'investiture au critique du régime Biya. Mais, le Fsnc, pour des raisons liées à la crise postélectorale d'octobre 2025 a annoncé le boycott des prochaines élections. Il reste l'option du MRC. Aussi, il revient au potentiel candidat à la députation ou à la mairie, de trouver un parti, le MRC ou un autre, qu'il juge favorable, en vue de son élection. ‘’Le parti qui sera le mieux placé selon mon appréciation, je me présenterais sous sa bannière’’, explique-t-il. Quant à la circonscription électorale, le syndicaliste radical entend se présenter dans son Sud natal. Il pourrait par exemple, pour les élections municipales, viser la mairie de Zoetele, sa commune d'origine. Et pour les législatives, se présenter dans le département du Dja-et-Lobo. Il aura pour défi majeur de remporter le scrutin dans une région considérée comme "bastion imprenable du Rdpc", région d'origine du président Paul Biya, président national du parti au pouvoir. Lequel parti est au front pour consolider ses majorités dans les conseils municipaux, ainsi qu'à l'Assemblée nationale. Cette réalité ne provoque aucune peur chez l’opposant. ‘’Il faut briser le mythe d’une terre se sainteté politique. Ça doit s’arrêter’’, martèle l’homme.  L’enseignant des universités affiche une détermination destinée à le porter à la victoire. Motivé aussi bien par la décrépitude de l'Etat que par le traitement qu'il a subi au terme de la présidentielle d'octobre 2025 (arrêté puis incarcéré avant d'être relâché), le juriste publiciste reste convaincu que le changement est possible par les urnes. Cet article Cameroun : le Pr Aba’a Oyono annonce son intention de se présenter aux élections municipales et législatives est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Cameroon: Professor Aba’a Oyono announces his intention to run in municipal and legislative elections
data.translatedDescription: © DR The academic and rigid critic of the regime expresses his desire to start winning votes in the next local and parliamentary elections. This is a surprise coming from someone who refuses positions as rector or minister under the current regime. Because, he says, the conditions are not met. Professor Jean Calvin Aba'a Oyono wants to start the race for power starting at the base, then the intermediate level. The opponent of the Yaoundé regime announced Sunday on the show L'Arène on the Canal 2 international channel that he is preparing to run in the next elections. When listening to politics, two parameters come into play. The first concerns the political party under whose banner he will run. The second is the electoral district. Regarding the political party, Aba'a Oyono has recently supported two political leaders. Maurice Kamto of the MRC then of Manidem during the presidential election and Issa Tchiroma Bakary of the Fsnc. The two political parties are those who can a priori grant the nomination to the critic of the Biya regime. But, the Fsnc, for reasons linked to the post-electoral crisis of October 2025, announced the boycott of the next elections. There remains the option of the MRC. Also, it is up to the potential candidate for deputy or mayor to find a party, the MRC or another, that he considers favorable, with a view to his election. “The party that is best placed according to my assessment, I would run under its banner,” he explains. As for the electoral district, the radical trade unionist intends to run in his native South. For example, for the municipal elections, he could target the town hall of Zoetele, his commune of origin. And for the legislative elections, run in the Dja-et-Lobo department. His major challenge will be to win the election in a region considered an "impregnable bastion of the Rdpc", the region of origin of President Paul Biya, national president of the ruling party. Which party is at the front to consolidate its majorities in municipal councils, as well as in the National Assembly. This reality does not cause any fear in the opponent. “We must break the myth of a land of political holiness. This has to stop,’ insists the man.  The university teacher displays a determination destined to bring him to victory. Motivated both by the decrepitude of the State and by the treatment he suffered at the end of the presidential election of October 2025 (arrested then incarcerated before being released), the legal publicist remains convinced that change is possible through the ballot box. data.title: Journée internationale de la paix 2026 : l’ONU appelle à « investir dans la paix » face à l’instabilité mondiale
data.description: La communauté internationale célèbre ce lundi 21 septembre la Journée internationale de la paix. Pour l’édition 2026, placée sous le thème « Investir dans la paix- Pour tous, partout, chaque jour », le secrétaire général des Nations unies, Antonio Guterres, appelle à renforcer les efforts en faveur de la paix, dans un contexte mondial marqué par de nombreuses crises.
data.translatedTitle: International Day of Peace 2026: UN calls to “invest in peace” in the face of global instability
data.translatedDescription: The international community is celebrating this Monday, September 21, the International Day of Peace. For the 2026 edition, placed under the theme “Investing in peace – For everyone, everywhere, every day”, the Secretary General of the United Nations, Antonio Guterres, calls for strengthening efforts in favor of peace, in a global context marked by numerous crises.

data.title: Le vaccin Ervebo administré aux agents de la riposte contre Ebola en Ituri
data.description: La vaccination des agents de première ligne dans la lutte contre Ebola a été officiellement lancée samedi 19 septembre par le gouverneur de province de l’Ituri. Cette vaccination s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une étude scientifique visant à déterminer le niveau de protection que le vaccin pourrait éventuellement offrir contre la souche Bundibugyo. Pour l’instant, seules les zones de santé de Bunia et de Mongwalu sont ciblées dans le cadre de cette vaccination.
data.translatedTitle: The Ervebo vaccine administered to agents of the response against Ebola in Ituri
data.translatedDescription: The vaccination of frontline workers in the fight against Ebola was officially launched on Saturday September 19 by the provincial governor of Ituri. This vaccination is part of a scientific study aimed at determining the level of protection that the vaccine could possibly offer against the Bundibugyo strain. For the moment, only the health zones of Bunia and Mongwalu are targeted for this vaccination.

data.title: La sécheresse menace les cultures de café et de banane à Kibirizi au Nord-Kivu
data.description: Les agriculteurs de Kibirizi, dans la chefferie de Bwito, en territoire de Rutshuru (Nord-Kivu), font face aux effets d’une période de sécheresse observée entre fin juillet et mi-septembre. Ils ont précisé dimanche 20 septembre, que le déficit de pluies affecte principalement les cultures de café et de banane, importantes pour les revenus de nombreux ménages.
data.translatedTitle: Drought threatens coffee and banana crops in Kibirizi in North Kivu
data.translatedDescription: Farmers in Kibirizi, in the Bwito chiefdom, in Rutshuru territory (North Kivu), are facing the effects of a period of drought observed between the end of July and mid-September. data.title: Bunia : des tirs dans le site des déplacés de Mudzi-Mpela
data.description: À Mudzi-Mpela, un quartier de la ville de Bunia en Ituri, la situation a été tendue ce dimanche 20 septembre matin après des tirs entendus tôt autour du site des déplacés de Kigonze. Plusieurs témoignages font état de morts et de blessés, ainsi que d’arrestations et de pillages. Le commandant urbain de la police, contacté dans la matinée, n’a pas souhaité donner davantage de précisions, estimant que les opérations étaient toujours en cours. Sur place, les habitants du site sont restés terrés chez eux.
data.translatedTitle: Bunia: shots fired at the Mudzi-Mpela displaced persons site
data.translatedDescription: In Mudzi-Mpela, a district of the town of Bunia in Ituri, the situation was tense this Sunday, September 20 morning after shots were heard early around the site of the Kigonze displaced people. Several testimonies report deaths and injuries, as well as arrests and looting. The urban police commander, contacted in the morning, did not wish to provide further details, believing that operations were still in progress. On site, the inhabitants of the site remained holed up in their homes.

data.title: A la découverte de l’Ekikoveko, plat traditionnel Hema, avec le Prof. Bagamba Arali.
data.description: Aujourd’hui, Identité Culturelle met à l’honneur un mets emblématique du peuple Hema : l’Ekikoveko. Préparé avec de la banane plantain et du beurre frais, ce plat chaud est traditionnellement servi au gendre lors du mariage coutumier. Mais au-delà de la recette, l’Ekikoveko porte en lui toute une mémoire : des valeurs, des symboles et un héritage transmis de génération en génération.
data.translatedTitle: Discovering Ekikoveko, a traditional Hema dish, with Prof. Bagamba Arali.
data.translatedDescription: Today, Cultural Identity is highlighting an emblematic dish of the Hema people: Ekikoveko. Prepared with plantain and fresh butter, this hot dish is traditionally served to the son-in-law during the customary wedding. But beyond the recipe, Ekikoveko carries with it a whole memory: values, symbols and a heritage passed down from generation to generation.

data.title: Beyond vehicle age: Why Ghana needs a smarter vehicle import policy
data.description:
The Ghana Standards Authority’s decision to strengthen enforcement of vehicle import standards from October 1, 2026, including restrictions on used vehicles above 15 years old, deserves serious national discussion. The objectives—safer roads, cleaner air, better consumer protection and a more responsible automotive industry—are legitimate and necessary.

However, age alone should not become the primary measure of whether a vehicle is safe, reliable or environmentally acceptable.

As a mechanical engineer with experience in vehicle maintenance, technical training and product support, I have seen that two vehicles of the same age can be in completely different mechanical conditions. A well-maintained older vehicle can, in some circumstances, be safer and more reliable than a poorly maintained newer one.

data.title: Tabla de posiciones Liga Nacional: Olimpia sonríe y nuevo líder tras tropiezo de Marathón
data.description: La octava jornada del Torneo Apertura 2026 de la Liga Nacional de Honduras terminó con un nuevo líder. Real España se queda con el primer lugar de la tabla de posiciones luego de la derrota que sufrió el Marathón contra el Juticalpa FC . La Máquina aprovechó su triunfo 1-0 sobre Motagua y terminó la fecha en lo más alto de la clasificación con 18 puntos. El conjunto aurinegro había hecho su trabajo el sábado en el estadio Morazán, donde derrotó al vigente campeón con un solitario gol de Nixon Cruz al minuto 80. Ese resultado le permitió asumir provisionalmente el liderato, a la espera de lo que ocurriera este domingo con Marathón y Olimpia . Sin embargo, el gran golpe de la jornada llegó en el estadio Juan Ramón Brevé Vargas, donde Juticalpa FC sorprendió al Marathón y lo derrotó 3-2 . El conjunto verdolaga tenía la oportunidad de recuperar la cima, pero terminó desaprovechando esa posibilidad y sufrió una derrota que lo hizo caer hasta la tercera posición. El tropiezo del Monstruo Verde fue aprovechado por Olimpia . Los dirigidos por Eduardo Espinel no tuvieron piedad del Atlético Independiente y lo vapulearon 4-0, resultado que les permitió escalar hasta la segunda posición con 17 puntos, los mismos que Marathón , pero con mejor diferencia de goles. De esta manera, Real España cierra la octava jornada en la cima con 18 unidades, seguido por Olimpia y Marathón , ambos con 17. Motagua, tras su derrota ante los aurinegros, se mantiene en la cuarta posición con 13 puntos, mientras que Génesis FC ocupa el quinto lugar con 10 unidades después de su empate 0-0 ante Olancho FC . Precisamente, Los Potros se ubican sexto con 10 puntos, seguido por CD Estrella Roja con nueve. Atlético Independiente aparece octavo también con nueve unidades, pero por debajo del conjunto de Danlí debido a su diferencia de goles. Lobos UPNFM es noveno con ocho puntos, mientras que CD Choloma ocupa la décima posición con siete. Juticalpa FC , protagonista de la gran sorpresa de la jornada, escaló hasta el undécimo puesto con seis puntos gracias a su triunfo sobre Marathón , dejando a Platense en el último lugar de la clasificación con apenas tres unidades después de ocho jornadas disputadas.
data.translatedTitle: National League standings: Olimpia smiles and new leader after Marathón's setback
data.translatedDescription: The eighth day of the 2026 Apertura Tournament of the Honduran National League ended with a new leader. Real España remains in first place in the standings after the defeat suffered by Marathón against Juticalpa FC. La Maquina took advantage of its 1-0 victory over Motagua and finished the date at the top of the standings with 18 points. The Aurinegro team had done its job on Saturday at the Morazán stadium, where it defeated the current champion with a solitary goal from Nixon Cruz in the 80th minute. That result allowed it to provisionally assume the lead, waiting for what happened this Sunday with Marathón and Olimpia. However, the big blow of the day came at the Juan Ramón Brevé Vargas stadium, where Juticalpa FC surprised Marathón and defeated them 3-2. The purslane team had the opportunity to regain the top spot, but ended up wasting that opportunity and suffered a defeat that made them fall to third position. The Green Monster's stumble was taken advantage of by Olimpia. Those led by Eduardo Espinel had no mercy on Atlético Independiente and beat them 4-0, a result that allowed them to climb to second position with 17 points, the same as Marathón, but with a better goal difference. In this way, Real España closes the eighth day at the top with 18 points, followed by Olimpia and Marathón, both with 17. Motagua, after its defeat against the Aurinegros, remains in fourth position with 13 points, while Génesis FC occupies fifth place with 10 points after its 0-0 draw against Olancho FC. Precisely, Los Potros are sixth with 10 points, followed by CD Estrella Roja with nine. Atlético Independiente also appears eighth with nine points, but below Danlí's team due to its goal difference. Lobos UPNFM is ninth with eight points, while CD Choloma occupies tenth position with seven. Juticalpa FC, protagonist of the big surprise of the day, climbed to eleventh place with six points thanks to its victory over Marathón, leaving Platense in last place in the standings with just three points after eight days played.

data.title: Jorge Álvarez, convocado a la Selección de Honduras por baja de figura de Liga Nacional
data.description: La Selección Nacional de Honduras registra un cambio de última hora en su convocatoria, a pocas horas de que comience la concentración del equipo para sus próximos compromisos por la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf . El mediocampista del Olimpia , Jorge Álvarez , se incorpora a la Bicolor en sustitución de Nixon Cruz , quien finalmente causa baja de la convocatoria debido a una lesión, según la información que ha hecho oficial la Federación de Fútbol de Honduras (FFH). La salida de Nixon Cruz genera sorpresa, especialmente porque el futbolista de Real España venía de ser protagonista en la reciente jornada del Torneo Apertura 2026 . El mediocampista marcó el gol con el que el conjunto aurinegro se impuso a Motagua en el clásico, convirtiéndose así en la figura del triunfo sampedrano. Cruz terminó el partido con molestias en la rodilla. Este domingo fue sometido a exámenes médicos y, por recomendación del cuerpo médico, se determinó que deberá guardar cinco días de reposo, por lo que no podrá incorporarse a la convocatoria de la Selección Nacional de Honduras . Ante esta situación, el cuerpo técnico encabezado por José Francisco Molina decidió llamar a Jorge Álvarez . El mediocampista de Olimpia , que inicialmente no figuraba entre los convocados, recibe así la oportunidad de incorporarse al grupo para afrontar los próximos compromisos de la Bicolor. Álvarez se suma a una convocatoria que tendrá importantes desafíos en la Liga de Naciones de Concacaf . Honduras deberá afrontar una serie de partidos ante Surinam , Martinica y Jamaica , torneo que será la primera prueba de fuego para el entrenador español. Los partidos de Honduras están programados para el 25 de septiembre ante Surinam , como local; luego visitará a Jamaica el lunes 28. Posteriormente, la Bicolor viajará a Martinica para enfrentar a los locales el 2 de octubre y cerrará esta ventana internacional el lunes 5 de octubre, nuevamente en casa, ante Jamaica .
data.translatedTitle: Jorge Álvarez, summoned to the Honduras National Team due to loss of figure from the National League
data.translatedDescription: The Honduran National Team registers a last-minute change in its call, a few hours before the team's concentration begins for its next commitments in the Concacaf Nations League. The Olimpia midfielder, Jorge Álvarez, joins the Bicolor to replace Nixon Cruz, who finally drops out of the squad due to an injury, according to information made official by the Honduras Football Federation (FFH). The departure of Nixon Cruz generates surprise, especially because the Real España footballer had just been the protagonist in the recent day of the 2026 Apertura Tournament. The midfielder scored the goal with which the Aurinegro team beat Motagua in the classic, thus becoming the figure of the Sampedran triumph. Cruz finished the game with knee discomfort. This Sunday he underwent medical examinations and, upon recommendation of the medical team, it was determined that he must rest for five days, so he will not be able to join the call for the Honduran National Team. Given this situation, the coaching staff headed by José Francisco Molina decided to call Jorge Álvarez. The Olimpia midfielder, who was not initially among those called up, thus receives the opportunity to join the group to face the Bicolor's next commitments. Álvarez joins a squad that will have important challenges in the Concacaf Nations League. Honduras will have to face a series of matches against Suriname, Martinique and Jamaica, a tournament that will be the first litmus test for the Spanish coach. Honduras' matches are scheduled for September 25 against Suriname, at home; Then they will visit Jamaica on Monday the 28th. Subsequently, the Bicolor will travel to Martinique to face the locals on October 2 and will close this international window on Monday, October 5, again at home, against Jamaica.

data.title: Juticalpa FC remonta y acaba con el invicto del Marathón en la Liga Nacional de Honduras
data.description: El Juticalpa FC dio el batacazo de la octava jornada al vencer con remontada incluida 3-2 al Marathón , pese a que comenzó perdiendo muy temprano en el partido y que los verdolagas llegaban con la oportunidad de seguir como líderes del Torneo Apertura 2026 . El invitado de lujo no tardó en llegar al estadio Juan Ramón Brevé Vargas, aunque no fue de la manera que se esperaba ya que Óscar Barrios tras un centro desde la derecha de Carlos Argueta marcó en su propia portería. El Juticalpa logró reaccionar rápido, un centro desde la derecha, Natanael Martínez intentó despejar, pero como llegaba desde atrás se complica, desvía el balón a su compañero Damín Ramírez que esperaba, dejando servido a Cristian Sacaza que al estar de frente no perdonó y la mandó al fondo. Lo locales se inspiraron con el gol ya marcado, llegan al área, la defensa verdolaga despejó y le cayó a Maylor Núñez que al tener el espacio manda el centro y Jairo Róchez de cabeza conceta pero llegó el momento de Jonathan Rougier para hacer un tapadón y mandarla al tiro de esquina. La respuesta del Marathón fue rápida y efectiva que con una llegada por la izquierda de José Aguilera , quien envió el centro para que llegara solo a cerrar Carlos Argueta a empujarla de pierna derecha al minuto 24 y volver a ponerse en ventaja. El partido estaba entretenido, ida y vuelta. Tiro libre para los locales que ejecutó Cristian Sacaza , en el área esperaba Junior Padilla que llega de pierna derecha solo para mandarla, en el otro poste cerraba Jairo Róchez que parecía que la había tocado, pero no, fue del número 17 al minuto 38'. Jhon Jairo López se atrevió, quería un resultado favorable para su equipo, hace el ingreso de Kelvin Matute y Kolton Kelly , este último mandó un centro al 55' a Jairo Róchez que llegaba solo en el área, conecta de cabeza y Rougier salva milagrosamente. Jugada polémica se dio al minuto 60 cuando de parte del Marathón pidieron revisión de una entrada de Roger González sobre Carlos Pérez de un supuesto penal, pero el árbitro Jefferson Escobar no sancionó nada. Otra revisión en el FVS, esta vez fue el Juticalpa que pidió que se viera mejor una barrida de Damín Ramírez contra Kolton Kelly que el árbitro sancionó y amonestó, pero luego de ser visto en la pantalla, anuló la tarjeta y lo expulsó. Los locales al tener un hombre menos en la cancha se fueron en busca del triunfo y se pusieron a ganar al minuto 85 tras un cabezazo de Jorge Velásquez luego de un tiro de esquina. Al final el marcador no se iba a mover. El triunfo de Marathón en la pasada fecha ante Olimpia no ayudó de nada para este juego ante un inspirado Juticalpa que vino de atrás para llevarse el triunfo y así llegar a seis puntos. 3 - JUTICALPA FC: 35. data.translatedTitle: Juticalpa FC comes back and ends the undefeated Marathón in the National League of Honduras
data.translatedDescription: Juticalpa FC hit the ball on matchday eight by beating Marathón 3-2 with a comeback, despite the fact that they started losing very early in the game and that the Purslanes arrived with the opportunity to continue as leaders of the 2026 Apertura Tournament. The luxury guest did not take long to arrive at the Juan Ramón Brevé Vargas stadium, although it was not the way expected since Óscar Barrios, after a cross from the right by Carlos Argueta, scored into his own goal. Juticalpa managed to react quickly, a cross from the right, Natanael Martínez tried to clear it, but as it came from behind it got complicated, he deflected the ball to his teammate Damín Ramírez who was waiting, leaving Cristian Sacaza serving, who, being in front, did not forgive and sent it to the back. The locals were inspired by the goal already scored, they arrived at the area, the purslane defense cleared and it fell to Maylor Núñez who, having the space, sent the center and Jairo Róchez headed the ball but it was time for Jonathan Rougier to make a block and send it to the corner kick. Marathón's response was quick and effective with an arrival from the left by José Aguilera, who sent the center so that only Carlos Argueta could close it and push it with his right foot in the 24th minute and take the lead again. The game was entertaining, back and forth. Free kick for the locals executed by Cristian Sacaza, in the area waiting for Junior Padilla who arrives with his right leg only to send it, at the other post Jairo Róchez closed it and it seemed that he had touched it, but no, it was from number 17 in the 38th minute. Jhon Jairo López dared, he wanted a favorable result for his team, he brought on Kelvin Matute and Kolton Kelly, the latter sent a cross at 55' to Jairo Róchez who arrived alone in the area, connected with a header and Rougier miraculously saved. A controversial play occurred in the 60th minute when the Marathón requested a review of a tackle by Roger González on Carlos Pérez for an alleged penalty, but referee Jefferson Escobar did not sanction anything. Another review in the FVS, this time it was Juticalpa who asked for a better view of a sweep by Damín Ramírez against Kolton Kelly that the referee sanctioned and reprimanded, but after being seen on the screen, he annulled the card and sent him off. The locals, having one less man on the field, went in search of victory and went on to win in the 85th minute after a header from Jorge Velásquez after a corner kick. In the end the scoreboard was not going to move. data.title: La Mujer de la Chumpa: la leyenda de Aurorita que San Nicolás se niega a olvidar
data.description: San Nicolás, Santa Bárbara. En este municipio del occidente de Honduras, una historia permanece viva en la memoria de sus habitantes desde hace casi cinco décadas. Es la historia de Alma Aurora Caballero Carranza, conocida cariñosamente como Aurorita, una joven que murió el 27 de diciembre de 1976 y cuyo nombre quedó ligado, con el paso de los años, a una de las leyendas más conocidas de San Nicolás: la Mujer de la Chumpa. El relato habla de una aparición, un conductor de vehículo y una prenda que habría sido entregada a la familia de la joven después de su muerte. La historia fue recogida y difundida por el reconocido escritor y folclorista hondureño Jorge Montenegro en su obra Cuentos y Leyendas de Honduras y, con el tiempo, trascendió las fronteras de la comunidad. Pero detrás de la leyenda existe una mujer real. Aurora Caballero vivió en San Nicolás, Santa Bárbara, y sus restos permanecen en el mausoleo familiar ubicado en el cementerio del municipio. Es precisamente en este lugar donde la tradición oral sitúa buena parte del relato que, generación tras generación, los habitantes han continuado contando. Según el testimonio de Chepito Reyes, uno de los habitantes de San Nicolás que conoce la historia, Aurora era hija de Luis Alonso Caballero. Reyes relata que la joven habría pedido permiso a su padre para asistir a un baile junto a un amigo, pero que la autorización le fue negada. De acuerdo con esta versión, aquella situación habría desencadenado una tragedia familiar y Aurora posteriormente se habría quitado la vida. Meses después habría ocurrido el episodio que convertiría su historia en leyenda. Cuenta Reyes que un hombre que viajaba desde Santa Bárbara, cuando todavía las carreteras de la zona eran de tierra, habría encontrado a una joven en el camino y le habría permitido subir a su vehículo. Durante el trayecto, la mujer le habría pedido que la llevara hasta la vivienda de la familia Caballero. Antes de bajar, le entregó una chumpa y le pidió al conductor que se la entregara a su padre al día siguiente. El hombre cumplió con el encargo. Al llegar donde Luis Alonso Caballero y explicarle que había llevado a su hija hasta la casa, recibió una respuesta que, según el relato, lo dejó desconcertado: Aurora había muerto tiempo atrás. El conductor habría descubierto entonces que la mujer a quien había transportado no podía haber sido Aurora. La impresión, según la tradición oral, habría sido tan fuerte que el hombre sufrió un profundo impacto emocional y posteriormente no se volvió a conocer información sobre su paradero. ¿Ocurrió realmente aquella aparición? No existen elementos que permitan comprobar de manera independiente que el conductor haya transportado a una persona fallecida. Lo que sí puede establecerse, según la información disponible en este relato, es que Aurora Caballero existió, vivió en San Nicolás y murió el 27 de diciembre de 1976. El episodio de la chumpa forma parte de una tradición oral que ha sobrevivido durante generaciones y que posteriormente fue difundida por medios y escritores dedicados a recopilar las leyendas hondureñas. Para Chepito Reyes, sin embargo, no hay duda sobre la veracidad del relato. “Es una historia real”, sostiene al recordar lo que durante décadas ha escuchado en su comunidad. La historia, además, no terminó con Aurorita. Reyes asegura que en los últimos años también ha escuchado relatos similares relacionados con otras personas y vehículos en las carreteras de la zona. Pero en estos casos reconoce que se trata de historias que conoce por el testimonio de terceros y que él mismo no ha presenciado. Al caer la noche, el cementerio de San Nicolás adquiere otro aspecto. El silencio, la oscuridad y el antiguo camino que conduce hasta el mausoleo contribuyen a mantener vivo el misterio. Pero más allá de lo sobrenatural, la historia de Aurorita revela algo profundamente humano: la manera en que una comunidad conserva sus recuerdos y los transmite de una generación a otra. Con el paso de los años, los detalles pueden cambiar, las versiones pueden multiplicarse y la frontera entre historia y leyenda puede hacerse cada vez más difícil de distinguir. Lo que permanece es el nombre de una joven. Alma Aurora Caballero Carranza. Para algunos, Aurorita es parte de una historia sobrenatura l. Para otros, es el recuerdo de una tragedia familiar que el tiempo convirtió en leyenda. Y para San Nicolás, su historia continúa formando parte de la memoria colectiva. En el cementerio donde descansan sus restos, la chumpa continúa siendo mucho más que una prenda dentro de un relato: es el elemento que convirtió la historia de una joven de San Nicolás en una de las leyendas que todavía despiertan curiosidad dentro y fuera de Honduras.
data.translatedTitle: La Mujer de la Chumpa: the legend of Aurorita that San Nicolás refuses to forget
data.translatedDescription: Saint Nicholas, Santa Barbara. In this municipality in western Honduras, a story remains alive in the memory of its inhabitants for almost five decades. It is the story of Alma Aurora Caballero Carranza, affectionately known as Aurorita, a young woman who died on December 27, 1976 and whose name became linked, over the years, to one of the best-known legends of San Nicolás: the Chumpa Woman. The story speaks of an apparition, a vehicle driver and a piece of clothing that would have been given to the young woman's family after her death. The story was collected and disseminated by the renowned Honduran writer and folklorist Jorge Montenegro in his work Cuentos y Leyendas de Honduras and, over time, transcended the borders of the community. But behind the legend there is a real woman. Aurora Caballero lived in San Nicolás, Santa Bárbara, and her remains remain in the family mausoleum located in the municipality's cemetery. It is precisely in this place where oral tradition places a good part of the story that, generation after generation, the inhabitants have continued to tell. According to the testimony of Chepito Reyes, one of the residents of San Nicolás who knows the story, Aurora was the daughter of Luis Alonso Caballero. Reyes says that the young woman had asked her father for permission to attend a dance with a friend, but that permission was denied. According to this version, that situation would have triggered a family tragedy and Aurora would have subsequently taken her own life. Months later the episode would have occurred that would turn his story into legend. Reyes says that a man traveling from Santa Bárbara, when the roads in the area were still dirt, found a young woman on the road and allowed her to get into his vehicle. During the journey, the woman would have asked him to take her to the Caballero family home. Before getting off, he gave him a chumpa and asked the driver to deliver it to his father the next day. The man fulfilled the order. When he arrived at Luis Alonso Caballero and explained that he had taken his daughter home, he received an answer that, according to the story, left him disconcerted: Aurora had died some time ago. The driver would have then discovered that the woman he had transported could not have been Aurora. The impression, according to oral tradition, would have been so strong that the man suffered a profound emotional impact and subsequently no information about his whereabouts was known again. Did that apparition really happen? There are no elements that allow us to independently verify that the driver has transported a deceased person. What can be established, according to the information available in this story, is that Aurora Caballero existed, lived in San Nicolás and died on December 27, 1976. The chumpa episode is part of an oral tradition that has survived for generations and was subsequently disseminated by media and writers dedicated to collecting Honduran legends. For Chepito Reyes, however, there is no doubt about the veracity of the story. “It's a true story,” he says, remembering what he has heard in his community for decades. The story, furthermore, did not end with Aurorita. Reyes assures that in recent years he has also heard similar stories related to other people and vehicles on the roads in the area. But in these cases he recognizes that these are stories that he knows from the testimony of third parties and that he himself has not witnessed. As night falls, the San Nicolás cemetery takes on another aspect. The silence, the darkness and the ancient path that leads to the mausoleum contribute to keeping the mystery alive. But beyond the supernatural, Aurorita's story reveals something deeply human: the way a community preserves its memories and transmits them from one generation to another. As the years go by, details may change, versions may multiply, and the line between history and legend may become increasingly difficult to distinguish. What remains is the name of a young woman. Alma Aurora Caballero Carranza. For some, Aurora is part of a supernatural story. For others, it is the memory of a family tragedy that time turned into legend. And for San Nicolás, his story continues to be part of the collective memory. In the cemetery where her remains rest, the chumpa continues to be much more than a garment within a story: it is the element that turned the story of a young woman from San Nicolás into one of the legends that still arouses curiosity inside and outside of Honduras.

data.title: Capturan a presunto integrante de la banda de Berna en La Lima
data.description: La Lima, Honduras. Agentes de la Unidad Nacional Antisecuestros (UNAS) capturaron este domingo 20 de septiembre a un hombre señalado como presunto integrante de la banda de Berna, quien tenía una orden de captura por los delitos de secuestro agravado y asociación para delinquir. El detenido fue identificado como Orbin Enrique Velásquez Mendoza, de 29 años, alias Torba, originario de Puerto Cortés y residente en San Antonio de las Cañas, Comayagua. De acuerdo con el reporte policial, se desempeñaba como jornalero. La captura se ejecutó mediante labores de inteligencia desarrolladas en la colonia La Mesa, en La Lima, Cortés. Según las autoridades, Velásquez Mendoza es señalado de formar parte de una estructura criminal vinculada a delitos como secuestro, sicariato, tráfico de drogas y tráfico de armas. La orden de captura contra el sospechoso fue emitida el 31 de octubre de 2024 por el Juzgado de Letras Penal con Competencia Nacional en Materia de Criminalidad Organizada, Medio Ambiente y Corrupción de San Pedro Sula, dentro del expediente 264-2024. El caso está relacionado con la desaparición de José Octavio Sosa Méndez y 11 personas que lo acompañaban, ocurrida el 12 de junio de 2024 en el sector de los bajos de Baracoa, Puerto Cortés. Según las investigaciones policiales, el grupo se dirigía a conocer unos terrenos cuando fue interceptado por hombres armados. Las autoridades han señalado que las víctimas fueron trasladadas posteriormente hacia el sector de Crique Las Marías, en Tela, Atlántida. Investigaciones de la UNAS establecieron que una vivienda vinculada a José Bernabé Acevedo Murcia, alias Berna, habría sido utilizada como sitio de cautiverio. Los cuerpos de Sosa Méndez y sus acompañantes no han sido localizados hasta la fecha. El caso generó además otro episodio de desapariciones en la zona. El 17 de junio de 2024, 14 habitantes de Crique Las Marías fueron privados de su libertad, según las investigaciones, en un hecho relacionado con el secuestro de Sosa Méndez y sus acompañantes. La Policía vinculó ambos acontecimientos con una disputa entre estructuras dedicadas al narcotráfico. En marzo de 2025, la Policía Nacional informó que 13 de las personas desaparecidas en Crique Las Marías fueron encontradas con vida después de 267 días de cautiverio. El grupo fue localizado en un embarcadero cercano a una playa de Tela y quedó bajo resguardo de las autoridades. Las investigaciones por el caso de Sosa Méndez y sus acompañantes han derivado en varias capturas y procesos judiciales contra supuestos integrantes de la banda de Berna. El Ministerio Público informó en octubre de 2025 que dos personas fueron condenadas mediante procedimiento abreviado por asociación para delinquir y que otras permanecían bajo proceso por su presunta vinculación con la organización. Tras su captura este domingo, Orbin Enrique Velásquez Mendoza será puesto a disposición del juzgado que emitió la orden, donde deberá continuar el procedimiento legal correspondiente y se determinará su situación legal. La acusación en su contra es de carácter provisional mientras avanza el proceso judicial.
data.translatedTitle: They capture an alleged member of the Berna gang in La Lima
data.translatedDescription: Lima, Honduras. Agents of the National Anti-Kidnapping Unit (UNAS) captured this Sunday, September 20, a man identified as an alleged member of the Berna gang, who had an arrest warrant for the crimes of aggravated kidnapping and association to commit a crime. The detainee was identified as Orbin Enrique Velásquez Mendoza, 29 years old, alias Torba, originally from Puerto Cortés and resident in San Antonio de las Cañas, Comayagua. According to the police report, he worked as a day laborer. The capture was carried out through intelligence work carried out in the La Mesa neighborhood, in La Lima, Cortés. According to the authorities, Velásquez Mendoza is accused of being part of a criminal structure linked to crimes such as kidnapping, hitmen, drug trafficking and weapons trafficking. The arrest warrant against the suspect was issued on October 31, 2024 by the Criminal Court with National Jurisdiction in Matters of Organized Crime, Environment and Corruption of San Pedro Sula, within file 264-2024. The case is related to the disappearance of José Octavio Sosa Méndez and 11 people who accompanied him, which occurred on June 12, 2024 in the lower area of ​​Baracoa, Puerto Cortés. According to police investigations, the group was going to visit some land when they were intercepted by armed men. The authorities have indicated that the victims were later transferred to the Crique Las Marías sector, in Tela, Atlántida. UNAS investigations established that a home linked to José Bernabé Acevedo Murcia, alias Berna, would have been used as a place of captivity. The bodies of Sosa Méndez and his companions have not been located to date. The case also generated another episode of disappearances in the area. On June 17, 2024, 14 residents of Crique Las Marías were deprived of their liberty, according to investigations, in an event related to the kidnapping of Sosa Méndez and his companions. The Police linked both events to a dispute between structures dedicated to drug trafficking. In March 2025, the National Police reported that 13 of the people missing in Crique Las Marías were found alive after 267 days of captivity. The group was located on a pier near a beach in Tela and was under the protection of the authorities. The investigations into the case of Sosa Méndez and his companions have led to several arrests and judicial proceedings against alleged members of the Berna gang. The Public Ministry reported in October 2025 that two people were convicted through an abbreviated procedure for criminal association and that others remained under trial for their alleged connection with the organization. After his capture this Sunday, Orbin Enrique Velásquez Mendoza will be placed at the disposal of the court that issued the order, where the corresponding legal procedure must continue and his legal situation will be determined. The accusation against him is provisional while the judicial process progresses.
